I'm sorry to say this when you're working so hard to help us, but how about searching for some other work? I think It's a shame to let your skills go to waste.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
很抱歉在您这么努力帮助我们的时候说这些，但您不妨去找找其他工作？我觉得让您的技能被浪费掉太可惜了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我听说蜂蜜采集需要人手，您可以去见见^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我听说普罗克现在需要帮忙。您不妨去见见^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000？感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
说到这个，^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000说他也需要帮忙。您愿意试试吗？感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
住在蝮蛇洞穴入口处的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地寻找强者。也许您可以去试试，当作积累经验。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的选择。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Thank you. Now our cows can enjoy delicious meal.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
谢谢。现在我们的奶牛可以享用美味的大餐了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
But you seem too skilled to do this kind of work. There are many other jobs that require physical strength, so perhaps you should go seek them.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
但您看起来太熟练了，不适合做这种工作。有很多其他需要体力的工作，也许您应该去寻求那些机会。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Not today. Maybe tomorrow? Let me see... Who said needed some help?
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
今天不行。也许明天？让我想想... 谁说过需要帮忙来着？

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我听说蜂蜜采集需要人手，您可以去见见^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我听说普罗克现在需要帮忙。您不妨去见见^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000？感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:

[Shepherd]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
住在蝮蛇洞穴入口处的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地寻找强者。也许您可以去试试，当作积累经验。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的选择。感谢您帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Hey cows- eat a lot and relax a lot- I'll sing you a song-
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
嘿，奶牛们——多吃多休息——我来给你们唱首歌——

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Hello, are you the person who's here to help us? Then you can start now.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
你好，你是来帮助我们的人吗？那么你可以现在开始了。

scripts.text: What is going on?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？

scripts.text: I'm not working.
scripts.translation: 我没在工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Work? That's out of the blue. No, I won't do it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
工作？这真是突然。不，我不干！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you need help, then you should at least tell me what I should do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你需要帮忙，至少该告诉我该做什么。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Oh, didn't the Chef tell you? I'm sorry, most people come here after hearing the details from him.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
哦，厨师没告诉你吗？抱歉，大多数人都是听了他说的详情后才来的。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Those Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are eating away the entire grass. But they shouldn't because they're leaving my cute cows here with no food.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
那些草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔正在吃光所有的草。但它们不该这样，因为它们留在这里让我的可爱奶牛们没东西吃。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Our cows have nothing to eat then.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我们的奶牛没东西吃了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
If our cows can't eat grass, then we can't milk them. If we have no fresh milk, then we can't make kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
如果我们的奶牛吃不到草，我们就无法挤奶。如果没有新鲜牛奶，我们就无法制作卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
And... Oh, I don't even want to imagine after that.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
而且...唉，我甚至不敢想象之后会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
So I need you to catch Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics. Five each. Okay, then start!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
所以，我需要你捕捉草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔。各五只。好的，开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
You're still not done yet. Please catch five Grass Fabres and five Leaf Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
你还没完成呢。请捕捉五只草地绿棉虫和五只群叶疯兔。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Mm...good. This area is settled now. You're really good at this.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
嗯...很好。这一带现在安全了。你真的很擅长这个。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Thank you so much. I hope you can help us again next time. So what'd you say? Please give it a thought.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
非常感谢。希望下次还能得到你的帮助。那么，你刚才说的是什么？请再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
there's nothing threatening around here right now. Our cows are satisfied with their meals, too.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
目前这一带没有威胁。我们的奶牛也吃得饱饱的。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Get some good rest and come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
好好休息，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Adventurer, please help! Packs of Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are coming this way!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
冒险者，请帮帮忙！成群的草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔正朝这边冲过来！

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Please catch five from each pack! I'll do whatever I can with the rest!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
请从每群中捕捉五只！剩下的我会尽力处理！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Adventurer, I know you're helping us right now but I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
冒险者，我知道你现在正在帮我们，但我认为你更适合去别的领域工作，而不是在这里。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我听说普罗克现在需要帮忙。你不妨去见见^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
说到这个，^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000说他也需要帮忙。你想试试吗？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
住在蛇蜥洞穴入口的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地寻找强者。也许你可以去试试，顺便练练级。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的主意。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
多亏了你，我们收集到了很多蜂蜜。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
但我认为你更适合去别的领域工作，而不是在这里。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你不介意的话，我可以给你找点工作吗？你今天已经做了很多了，请好好休息，明天见。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我听说普罗克现在需要帮忙。你不妨去见见^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

住在蛇蜥洞穴入口的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地寻找强者。也许你可以去试试，顺便练练级。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的主意。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I really like this job! I can smell sweet flowers and also get some honey!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我真的很喜欢这份工作！既能闻到甜甜的花香，又能采到蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
You're not taking my honey!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
你休想抢走我的蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch! Why are you hitting me all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哟！你干嘛突然打我？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Oh! I'm sorry. I thought it was the hornets again.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
啊！对不起。我以为是蜂兵又来了。

scripts.text: You look like you need help.
scripts.translation: 你看起来需要帮忙

scripts.text: Be careful next time.
scripts.translation: 下次小心点

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I almost got hurt. Please be careful next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我差点受伤了。下次请小心点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look like you need help. Want me to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来需要帮忙。要我帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Really... you'll help me? Even after I had hit you? Well, I'm so grateful if you can because I need some help right now.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
真的...你会帮我吗？就算我刚才打了你？既然你愿意，那我太感激了，因为我现在确实需要帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I'm collecting honey needed to ferment kaluna from the blooming flowers here, but our biggest rivals, the hornets, are taking everything before we even get a chance.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我正在采集酿造卡鲁纳所需的蜂蜜，但我们的最大对手蜂兵总是抢先一步，让我们根本采不到。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
At this rate, I won't have enough honey and won't be able to make kaluna milk. If people can't drink kaluna milk, then there will be a riot and...
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
照这样下去，我采不到足够的蜂蜜，就做不出卡鲁纳牛奶了。如果人们喝不到卡鲁纳牛奶，就会发生暴动...

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Adventurer, I beg you. We must stop Lasagna from going back to its dark ages. Everything is in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
冒险者，求求你了。我们必须阻止罗札纳回到黑暗时代。一切就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Please defeat our rivals, the wild hornets. Around ten would do.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
请击败我们的对手，狂野蜂兵。大概需要十只。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If you can defeat them, then I'll do whatever I can with the rest. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你能击败它们，剩下的交给我处理就好。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Oh, you're not done yet. Have you forgotten what you were supposed to catch?
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
哦，你还没做完呢。忘了你要抓什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
You need to catch ten wild hornets. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
你需要抓十只狂野蜂兵。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
多亏了你，我们收集到了很多蜂蜜。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
但我认为你更适合去别的领域工作，而不是在这里。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你不介意的话，我可以给你找点工作吗？你今天已经做了很多了，请好好休息，明天见。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我听说普罗克现在需要帮忙。你不妨去见见^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
The wild hornets are quiet right now. At this number, I can take care of them myself.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
现在狂野蜂兵很安静。就这个数量，我自己能应付。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Once the sun is up, they'll be back again. Could you come back then and help me?
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
太阳升起后，它们就会回来。到时候你能再来帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Nedsoli]
You look like you still need help today as well. Want me to help?
scripts.translation:
[内德索利]
你看起来今天还是需要帮忙。要我帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Ah, adventurer, I'm so glad you're here!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
啊，冒险者，你来了真好！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I need you to defeat our rival wild hornet today as well. Around ten hornets. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
今天也需要你击败我们的对手狂野蜂兵。大概十只。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
观察了你之后，我觉得你或许不适合这个领域，换个领域发展会更好。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
说到这个，^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000说他需要帮忙。你要不要试试？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在寻找强大的个体。为了积累经验，你不妨去试试。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的选择。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
观察了你之后，我觉得你或许不适合这个领域，换个领域发展会更好。

scripts.text:
[Prok]

scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
说到这个，^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000说他需要帮忙。你要不要试试？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在寻找强大的个体。为了积累经验，你不妨去试试。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的选择。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow, thank you! That was quick.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
哇，谢谢你！动作真快。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
But rather than working on this side, I think you should seek out for an adventure.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
不过，我觉得与其在这里工作，不如去寻求冒险。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
If you wish, I can find something for you. But not today. Perhaps tomorrow. Today you should get some rest.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
如果你愿意，我可以帮你找点事做。但不是今天，也许是明天。今天你应该好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
说到这个，^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000说他需要帮忙。你要不要试试？谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在寻找强大的个体。为了积累经验，你不妨去试试。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也是个不错的选择。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Slippery- sticky- It's amazing such creatures exist.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
滑溜溜的...粘糊糊的...真不敢相信竟然存在这样的生物。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Can you by any chance help me? If you have time, that is.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
如果你有空的话，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮你。

scripts.text: I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll help you next time. Sorry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在很忙。下次再帮你吧。抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow! Thank you! I need to take sticky webfeet but That's a bit hard to do alone.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
哇！谢谢你！我需要粘糊的蹼，但这一个人很难做到。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
This sticky webfoot is the main ingredient of pudding, but it goes bad quickly after a day. And smells awful, too.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
粘糊的蹼是布丁的主要原料，但放一天就会变质。而且味道很难闻。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
So every day, I must only collect how much I need for the day. But I still haven't collected enough for today.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
所以每天我只能采集当天需要的量。但我今天还没采集够。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Chef must be waiting... It's such a relief that you're helping me.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
厨师肯定在等着...幸好你愿意帮我。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Could you catch Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
你能捕捉甜心罗达蛙并给我粘糊的蹼吗？大概五只。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Um, did you really catch Sweet Roda Frog?
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
嗯，你真的捕捉了甜心罗达蛙吗？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You need to catch ten... I also need five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
你需要捕捉十只...我也需要五只粘糊的蹼。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
I asked for five sticky webfeet but I still need a bit more. I don't have enough time to collect them alone.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
我要了五只粘糊的蹼，但还是不够。我没有时间一个人去采集。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow, thank you! That was quick.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
哇，谢谢你！动作真快。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I ask for a favor again next time? I need to take fresh ones every day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我还能再麻烦你吗？我每天都要新鲜的。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You're here again. But I don't need sticky webfeet yet. What you sent yesterday is enough.
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
你又来了。但我现在不需要粘糊的蹼。你昨天送来的已经够了。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
But you never know, so can you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
不过世事难料，你明天能再来一趟吗？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You're here. Can you help me today as well?
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
你来了。今天也能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Could you catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[普罗克]
能帮我抓十只甜心罗达蛙，带些粘糊的蹼来吗？大概五只左右。谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, stop what you're doing just for a minute. I think I can handle it alone from here. You seem too strong for this type of work, you know.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
冒险者，请停下手中的事听我说。我觉得剩下的我自己能搞定。你的实力太强了，做这种工作有点大材小用。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有蝾螈出没的洞穴入口附近，它正在寻找强者。也许你可以去试试，就当是积累经验了。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船出发，去寻找更大的冒险，这也是个好主意。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Thank you so much. I bet they'll be scared to show up for a while.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
非常感谢。我想它们短时间内不敢再来了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
But I think you should seek for bigger adventures. don't let your skills go to waste in this boondocks and go out to a bigger place.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
不过我觉得你应该去寻找更大的冒险。别让你的技艺荒废在这偏僻之地，去更广阔的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Right. There was someone who needed help. You had a long day today, so perhaps you should go see him tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
没错。之前有人需要帮忙。你今天辛苦了，也许明天再去看看他比较好。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有蝾螈出没的洞穴入口附近，它正在寻找强者。也许你可以去试试，就当是积累经验了。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
从^4D4DFF[码头]^000000乘船出发，去寻找更大的冒险，这也是个好主意。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Today's wind is good! The fish will dry nicely.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
今天的风不错！鱼干能晒得很好。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, what am I going to do. Hey you, adventurer! Hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哎呀，这可怎么办。喂，冒险者！等一下！

scripts.text: What's up?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Yeah? Then I guess there's nothing I can do.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
是吗？那我也没办法了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Take a look at those Desert Wolves. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
看看那些沙漠之狼。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Those monsters steal all the fish I'm drying right now!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
那些魔物偷走了我正在晾晒的鱼！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
What Hunter Desert Wolf in the world eats fish? A dried one, too!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哪有沙漠之狼吃鱼的？还是吃鱼干！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Then again...It's hard to forget this fish once you get a taste of it since the flavors are concentrated.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
不过话说回来...这种鱼味道浓郁，一旦尝过就很难忘记。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
But this is Chef's favorite snack. It's the only snack that picky eater likes.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
但这是厨师最喜欢的零食。它是挑食者唯一喜欢的零食。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Without it, we have to endure a very difficult time.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
没有它，我们要度过非常艰难的日子。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, there they are again! Adventurer, please keep them from coming here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦，它们又来了！冒险者，请阻止它们再来这里。抓十只。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Those Hunter Desert Wolves are rampaging still.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
那些沙漠之狼还在肆虐。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
At least ten should be caught.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
至少要抓十只。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, I was so desperate back then that I just grabbed anybody who passed by, but I think I hit the jackpot!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
冒险者，当时我走投无路，随便拉了个路人帮忙，没想到真是捡到宝了！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, don't take it the wrong way. Despite what it may seem, I'm really grateful from deep down. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦，别误会。虽然看起来可能不像，但我发自内心地感激你。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
I hope you can help me tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
希望明天也能得到你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
The Hunter Desert Wolves are quiet right now. They must've been shocked to see you in action.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
猎人沙漠狼现在安静多了。它们看到你出手的样子，肯定吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
So I hope you come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
所以希望明天你还能来！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, good to see you! They're fiercely coming at us. I guess they're real furious about not having any fish yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
冒险者，见到你真好！它们正凶猛地冲过来。看来它们对昨天没吃到鱼的事非常生气。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Whoa! There they are again! Adventure, please keep those Hunter Desert Wolves away from here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哇！它们又来了！冒险者，请把这些猎人沙漠狼赶远点。抓十只。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Don't block the sunlight meow...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
别挡住阳光喵...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者。我做了一个梦。梦里你正前往新世界喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我的梦通常都很准。所以停下你手头的事，去^4D4DFF[码头]^000000登上前往新世界的船吧。那里会有更大的冒险在等着你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
无论你去哪里，我都祝你一切顺利。谢谢你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者。我做了一个梦。梦里你正前往新世界喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我的梦通常都很准。所以停下你手头的事，去^4D4DFF[码头]^000000登上前往新世界的船吧。那里会有更大的冒险在等着你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
无论你去哪里，我都祝你一切顺利。谢谢你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. You're kind... You saved my life.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者。你真好...你救了我的命。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
But what are you doing in such a rustic place? Isn't it better that you go and search for a bigger world? Like the new world, for example.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
但你为什么待在这种偏僻的地方？去探索更广阔的世界不是更好吗？比如新世界。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
If I were you, I would've left long ago. You're not here because you don't know how to get there, right? If That's the case, then I'll tell you. I can do that much for my life's savior.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果是我的话，早就离开了。你留在这里，是因为不知道怎么去那里，对吧？如果是这样，我就告诉你吧。作为救命恩人，这点忙我还是可以帮的。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
If you go to Lasagna, there is a ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 there. Take a ship that goes to the new world from there. Wherever you go, I wish you the best. Thanks for everything meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果你去罗札纳，那里有一个^4D4DFF[码头]^000000。从那里坐船去新世界吧。无论你去哪里，我都祝你一切顺利。谢谢你的救命之恩喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer...please save me...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者...请救救我...

scripts.text: Why? What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 为什么？怎么了？

scripts.text: What do you mean, save you?
scripts.translation: 你说救你？是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think someone with more experience should take care of this. I'm still a rookie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得应该让更有经验的人来处理这件事。我还是个新人。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So cold-hearted...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
好冷酷无情...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I think I'm going to die at this rate...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
照这样下去，我好像要死了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dad, I mean, Chef, told me to get mushroom spores or something...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我爸爸，我是说厨师，让我去采香菇芽孢什么的...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
But look. The sunlight.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
但是你看。阳光。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I must bathe in the sunlight and sleep on days like this...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
在这样的日子里，我必须沐浴在阳光下睡觉...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
This sunlight is putting me to sleep meow...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
这阳光让我好困喵...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I was here, desperately fighting against the sunlight and waiting for someone to pass by meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我就在这里，拼命抵抗阳光，等着有人经过喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I think I'm going to die, trying to fight sleepiness meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我觉得我要死了，因为我在和困意作斗争喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So please get those mushroom spores for me cuz I'm dying meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以请帮我采那些香菇芽孢，因为我快死了喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
And while you're at it, beat those Trans Spores, too. I hate them meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
顺便把那些变形蘑菇也打了吧。我讨厌它们喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dad, I mean, Chef, gave me a training on entering caves so he can use me for such tasks meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我爸爸，我是说厨师，训练我进入洞穴，这样他就可以让我做这种任务喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So just the thought of them makes me all furious meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以光是想到它们我就很生气喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
What is that look in your eyes? Do you think I'm pathetic meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你那个眼神是什么意思？你觉得我很可怜喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
That's rude but It's okay. You're not the only one meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
这很无礼，但没关系。你不是唯一一个这样想的人喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
It's okay if you decide not to help meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果你决定不帮我，也没关系喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Even if I don't die here fighting against sleep, my dad, I mean, Chef, will kill me. Merely over mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
即使我不是在这里因困倦而死，我爸爸，我是说厨师，也会杀了我。仅仅因为香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
That's okay, too. I came back to life many times already. Long and deep sleep is all I need to revive meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
那也没关系。我已经复活过很多次了。只要睡个长觉就能复活喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So, please think of it as... saving someone's life...and help meeee...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以，请把它当作...救一个人的命...帮帮我吧...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer...? Are you waking me up cuz you're done? Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者...？你是因为做完了才把我叫醒的吗？让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wow, you're really done! That was so quick of you that I am wide awake. You really are a wonder!
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
哇，你真的做完了！你做得太快了，我现在都完全清醒了。你真是不可思议！

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Why don't you work at Pub-Oven instead of me? Then again, I'm sure you'd hate that, too.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你为什么不干脆去Pub-Oven工作，而不是帮我呢？不过话说回来，我相信你也会讨厌那里的。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I might need to get some mushroom spores or something tomorrow as well, so drop by again. I'm going to bring these quickly and relax. Thanks! I owe you.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
明天我可能还需要一些香菇芽孢之类的，所以请再来一趟。我要赶紧把这些送出去，然后休息一下。谢谢！我欠你一个人情。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Have you finished it already meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你已经做完了吗喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Of course not. This is not it. Did you forget already meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
当然没有。这不是那个任务。你已经忘记了吗喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Catch ten Trans Spores and bring five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
捕捉十只变形蘑菇，并带给我五个香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Call me when you're done. Don't wake me up for no reason meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
做完之后叫我。不要无缘无故叫醒我喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
there's no more for today, so can go...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
今天没有更多任务了，你可以走了...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
don't disturb my... sleep...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
别打扰我的...睡眠...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
An adventurer. The adventurer from yesterday. Great, please save me today as well meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒险者。昨天那位冒险者。太好了，请今天也救救我喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
There seems to be another bothersome fish cake order that came in. So please get the ingredients for me. I'm busy today as well, desperately fighting against the sunlight meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
似乎又有一单麻烦的鱼糕订单进来了。所以请帮我准备食材。我今天也很忙，正在拼命抵抗阳光喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Catch ten Trans Spores and bring them five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
捕捉十只变形蘑菇，并带给我五个香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Please...help me...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
请...帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You finished the job safe and sound. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你安全顺利地完成了工作。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但以你的技术，还留在这里工作未免太屈才了。不如去找点别的做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
去新世界冒险也不错。要不是因为这份工作，我早就离开了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
总之，谢谢你的帮忙。帮了大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I see that you were taking care of the favor I had asked.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
看来你一直在处理我拜托你的事情。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但以你的技术，还留在这里工作未免太屈才了。不如去找点别的做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I am not shameless enough to tie down a young person with such potential.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我还没有厚颜到要用这种潜力无限的人来束缚自己。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
去新世界冒险也不错。要不是因为这份工作，我早就离开了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
总之，谢谢你的帮忙。帮了大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I'm busy! So busy!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我很忙！非常忙！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Adventurer, can you do me a small favor? There are things I must do right now but as you can see, I am shorthanded. What'd you say?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
冒险者，能帮我个小忙吗？我现在手头有急事，但你也看到了，我人手不足。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Think of it as a continuation of your training and please help me. I'll give you a hefty wage, so what'd you say?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
就当是继续你的训练吧，请帮帮我。我会给你丰厚的报酬，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我试试看。

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在很忙。稍后再说。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Oh, thanks a bunch. What a relief, really!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
哦，太感谢了。真是帮了大忙！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Then Let's cut to the chase.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
那我们长话短说吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
All people from Lasagna love kaluna milk, but do you know what It's made of? Kaluna made from well-fermented kalunyak and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
罗札纳的人都喜欢卡鲁纳牛奶，但你知道它是怎么做的吗？是用发酵良好的卡鲁尼亚克和新鲜牛奶制成的卡鲁纳。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Do you know what the important things are when making kaluna milk? They're well-fermented kaluna and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你知道制作卡鲁纳牛奶最重要的东西是什么吗？是发酵良好的卡鲁尼亚克和新鲜牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I beg you. Please catch Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet! Without them, I can't make any pudding!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
拜托了。请去抓罗达蛙，给我带五只粘粘的脚掌！没有它们，我就做不了布丁了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My strings still Aren't here. It must be those Desert Wolves again.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我的线还没到。肯定是那些沙漠狼又搞的鬼。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Do you know what Pub-Oven's signature menu is?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你知道Pub-Oven的招牌菜是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Our cow...should eat lots of tasty stuff... Please take care of five Leaf Lunatics and five Grass Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们的奶牛...应该多吃点好吃的...请帮我处理五只群叶疯兔和五只草地绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
You must hurry. We're almost done with the honey we have. Ten wild hornets!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你得快点。我们的蜂蜜快用完了。十只狂野蜂兵！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请帮我今天做点布丁。抓十只甜心罗达蛙，给我带五只粘粘的脚掌！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Please guard my strings. Catch ten Hunter Desert Wolves. That should be enough to keep them away from my strings.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请帮我看守我的线。抓十只猎人沙漠狼。那样应该就足够让它们远离我的线了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们今天能做点鱼糕吗？拜托了。请别让我让顾客空手而归。他们等了很久才来吃鱼糕。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Now our cows can have lots of tasty grasses. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
现在我们的奶牛可以吃到很多好吃的草了。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
You took care of those wild hornets safely. Just amazing.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你安全地处理了那些狂野蜂兵。真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Five sticky webfeet. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
五只粘粘的脚掌。完美。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Adventurer, I heard about your feats. Thanks to you, my strings are safe.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
冒险者，我听说你的壮举了。多亏了你，我的线很安全。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Five mushroom spores. Perfect. It was wise to ask an adventurer for help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
五朵香菇芽孢。完美。
向冒险者求助真是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
What, you're here already to help?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
什么，你已经来帮忙了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
As the recipe is simple, it takes good ingredients to come up with the best taste. So we get milk from our own cow that we raised.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
虽然食谱很简单，但要做出最好的味道，就需要优质的食材。
所以我们用自家养的奶牛来产奶。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I'm sure you've been to Raviol Plains. You must come from there.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我相信你肯定去过罗札纳平原。
你一定是从那里来的。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Where you must go is not the guard post. If you go south straight down, you'll see crossroads. Then go straight down underneath.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你要去的地方不是卫兵哨所。
一直往南走，你会看到十字路口。
然后继续直走，往下走。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
That's where our cows are grazing. Grass there is fresh and clean, so the milk tastes superb.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们的奶牛就在那里吃草。
那里的草新鲜又干净，所以牛奶味道极佳。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But the Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are devouring the grasses.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但是草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔正在吃光那些草。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So please go and get rid of them. Five from each group should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
所以请去把它们赶走。
每种各抓五只应该就够了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the ^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000 there.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
抓完所有之后你可以来找我，
也可以去那里找^4D4DFF[牧羊人]^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
无论在哪里，报酬都是一样的。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Kaluna is made by a kaluna master near the south bridge. I can't tell you what exactly goes in there because It's a trade secret, but I can tell you one thing.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
卡鲁纳是由南桥附近的一位卡鲁纳大师制作的。
我不能告诉你里面具体放了什么，因为那是商业机密，但我可以告诉你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's honey. Lasagna fields are covered with sweet flowers, so we can collect a lot of quality honey.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
是蜂蜜。罗札纳平原上开满了甜甜的花，
所以我们可以采集到很多优质蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But do you know what the greatest enemy is when collecting that honey? It's the wild hornet.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但你知道采集蜂蜜时最大的敌人是什么吗？
是狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
They're honey-crazy creatures who are masters when it comes to collecting honey... We can't get rid of them entirely since the flowers need to be pollenated, but there's a need to control their number.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
它们是痴迷于蜂蜜的生物，在采集蜂蜜方面也是行家...
既然花朵需要授粉，我们无法彻底消灭它们，
但必须控制它们的数量。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So when the time comes, we hire adventurers to hunt the wild hornets.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
所以到了时候，我们会雇佣冒险者去猎杀狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You should give it a try. Ten hornets Aren't too much of a burden.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你应该试一试。
十只蜂兵不算太重的负担。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000 who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以来找我，
或者去那里向正在采蜜的^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000汇报。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I beg you, please.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
拜托了，求你了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Roda Frogs. I always hated their slippery skin.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请抓十只罗达蛙。
我一直讨厌它们滑溜溜的皮肤。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
如果你能抓到粘粘的脚掌，可以带给我，
也可以交给^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000。反正他也答应会带过来的。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Hey adventurer, so what'd you say? won't you take care of those wolves and save our strings?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
嘿，冒险者，你刚才说什么来着？
难道你不愿意赶走那些狼，救救我们的鱼串吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are the strings?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鱼串是什么？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Dried fish. They are tied one after the other on a string, so we call them strings for short. But those Desert Wolves are a headache because they constantly finish them off.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
就是晒干的鱼。它们被一根接一根地串在绳子上，所以我们简称它们为“鱼串”。
但那些沙漠狼真是让人头疼，总是把它们吃光。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please take care of those Desert Wolves and save our strings. They're my favorite snack. Catch ten wolves and they won't come near anymore.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请赶走那些沙漠狼，救救我们的鱼串吧。
那是我最喜欢的零食。只要抓十只狼，它们就不会再靠近了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 who is drying fish there.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以来找我，
或者去那里向正在晒鱼的^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000汇报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kaluna milk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡鲁纳牛奶？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
No, no. That's the most popular menu. What I mean is... right! Chef's specialty menu is what I meant.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
不不不，那是最畅销的菜品。
我的意思是...对了！我是说厨师的招牌菜。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's the fish cake, there Aren't too many who ask for it. So we don't even have the ingredients in store.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
就是鱼糕，点它的人不多。
所以我们甚至没有备货。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So we get the ingredients immediately when there's an order.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
所以一旦有订单，我们会立刻去采购食材。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pub-Oven has its own special network where it receives ingredients within ten minutes. So customers don't need to wait infinitely.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
“Pub-Oven”有自己特殊的配送网络，能在十分钟内收到食材。
所以顾客不需要无限期地等待。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But as you know, there's no such thing as ����never���� in life. Yet, we always make the effort to achieve ����never.����
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但正如你所知，生活中没有“永不”这回事。
然而，我们总是努力追求“永不”。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
And right now, that effort is being challenged.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
而此刻，这种努力正受到挑战。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must've heard about the cave in Raviol Forest. There are unspeakable things as well as creatures that are delicious food ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你一定听说过拉维奥森林里的洞穴吧。
那里不仅有不可名状的东西，还有美味的食材生物。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You know the Trans Spores? Their ����mushroom spores���� are an essential ingredient for our fish cake.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你知道变形蘑菇吗？它们的“香菇芽孢”是我们制作鱼糕的必要食材。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But for some reason, they live with the basilisks, but so this is a serious problem for us.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
但不知为何，它们和石像鬼住在一起，这对我们来说是个严重的问题。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We sent someone in a hurry to find some mushroom spores, but nothing. No news at all.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们匆忙派人去找香菇芽孢，但一无所获。
完全没有消息。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's been 15 minutes since we sent a message but still no news. This must mean that he's probably sleeping nearby again.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
发消息已经15分钟了，还是没消息。
这肯定意味着他又在附近睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I didn't want to ask that sleepyhead for help, but he was the only person who was available.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我不太想求那个瞌睡虫帮忙，但他却是唯一有空的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you want me to get some mushroom spores, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你是想让我去弄些香菇芽孢，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My friend, you're quick and sensible. Yes, please get some mushroom spores.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
朋友，你反应真快，也很懂事。是的，请帮我弄些香菇芽孢。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
On your way, perhaps you can beat down Trans Spore for training purposes. Catch about ten Trans Spores as well.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
在去的路上，为了锻炼一下，你可以顺便打倒一些变形蘑菇。也请顺便抓大约10只变形蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And why is that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must get used to the job so that I can make you work again!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你得习惯这份工作，这样我才能让你继续干活！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
How can you force me to say such a thing?! You're so dense! Go, get going!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你怎么能逼我说出这种话呢？你真是迟钝！快去吧，赶紧出发！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring them to me when you're done, or you may give them to ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000. Also, don't forget to kick his behinds!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以把它们带给我，或者交给^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000。另外，别忘了踹他屁股！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our cow...should eat lots of tasty stuff... Please take care of five Leaf Lunatics and five Grass Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们的奶牛...应该多吃点美味的东西... 请帮我处理5只群叶疯兔和5只草地绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must hurry. We're almost done with the honey we have. Ten wild hornets!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你得快点。我们的蜂蜜快用完了。10只狂野蜂兵！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请帮我今天做点布丁。抓10只甜心罗达蛙，并给我带5个粘粘蛛丝！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please guard my strings. Catch ten Hunter Desert Wolves. That should be enough to keep them away from my strings.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请保护我的线。抓10只猎人沙漠狼。那样应该足够让它们远离我的线了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
今天能做些鱼饼吗？求求你了。请不要让我让顾客空手而归。他们等了很久才来买鱼饼。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请抓10只变形蘑菇，并给我带5个香菇芽孢。快一点！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Now our cows can have lots of tasty grasses. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
现在我们的奶牛可以吃到很多美味的草了。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our cows liked you very much. That's surprising because they're usually very shy.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们的奶牛很喜欢你。这真让人惊讶，因为它们通常非常害羞。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So can you do me another favor tomorrow? Oh, no need to answer right away. Get some good rest tonight and come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
那么明天能再帮我个忙吗？哦，不用马上回答。今晚好好休息，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You took care of those wild hornets safely. Just amazing.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你安全地处理了那些狂野蜂兵。真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So amazing that I want to ask for another favor tomorrow. Florin's been having a lot of difficulties lately.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
真了不起，我想明天再请你帮个忙。弗洛林最近遇到了很多困难。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Then see you again tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
那么明天见！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请帮我今天做点布丁。抓10只甜心罗达蛙，并给我带5个粘粘蛛丝！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Five sticky webfeet. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
5个粘粘蛛丝。完美。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Oh, thank you! You saved me! I wish you can get a taste of the pudding made with this, but I'm so busy at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
哦，谢谢你！你救了我！我真希望你能尝尝用这个做的布丁，但我现在太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
By the way, we're going to see each other again tomorrow, right?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
对了，我们明天还会再见的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Adventurer, I heard about your feats. Thanks to you, my strings are safe.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
冒险者，我听说你的英勇事迹了。多亏了你，我的琴弦才保住了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I must repay you for saving my strings. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我必须报答你救下我的琴弦。非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
And can you help me again tomorrow? I want to entrust my strings with someone reliable.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
明天你能再帮帮我吗？我想把琴弦托付给一个可靠的人。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
今天能做些鱼饼吗？求求你了。请不要让我让顾客空手而归。他们等了很久才来买鱼饼。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请抓10只变形蘑菇，并给我带5个香菇芽孢。快一点！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Five mushroom spores. Perfect. It was wise to ask an adventurer for help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
五个香菇芽孢。完美。向冒险者求助真是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We almost lost all our customers who wanted fish cake. Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们差点就失去了所有想吃鱼糕的顾客。太感谢了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
What, you're here already to help?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
什么，你这么快就来帮忙了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's too early right now. Pushing won't solve anything.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
现在太早了。催促解决不了任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Have a nice rest and come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
好好休息，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You here? Right when I needed some help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你来了？正好我需要帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Will you help today as well?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
今天你也会帮忙吗？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我会尽力。

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在很忙。稍后再说。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please guard the grasses from Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic. They are food for our cows.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请保护草地，免受草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔的侵害。那是我们奶牛的食物。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic, five each. That should scare the rest nearby and keep them at bay.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔，各五只。这应该能吓退附近其他的，让它们不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Once you cross the south bridge, you'll see crossroads. Take the road right underneath and go straight to the Raviol Plains where the shepherd is.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
过了南边的桥，你会看到十字路口。走正下方的路，一直走到牧羊人所在的拉维奥平原。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
抓完所有的之后你可以来找我，或者去找<NAVI>^4D4DFF[牧羊人]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
无论在哪里，报酬都是一样的。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
A new day has just begun, and so will the wild hornets with their activities.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
新的一天开始了，狂野蜂兵的活动也将随之开始。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our honey is in danger!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们的蜂蜜有危险了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please go to Raviol Forest and catch ten wild hornets.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请去拉维奥森林，抓十只狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以来找我，或者向正在那里采蜜的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>报告。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You should go to Ravioli Forest. Please bring five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
你应该去罗比奥森林。请带五只粘粘蛛脚回来。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
While you're there, catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs. Their population has increased too much recently.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
既然去了，顺便抓十只甜心罗达蛙吧。最近它们的数量增加得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
如果你拿到了粘粘蛛脚，可以带给我，也可以交给<NAVI>^4D4DFF[普罗克]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。反正他也答应要把它们带过来。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Listen carefully, because this is the most important request.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请仔细听，因为这是最重要的请求。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please keep the Hunter Desert Wolves away from my strings. Catch ten wolves and they won't go after my strings anymore.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请让猎人沙漠狼远离我的线。抓住十只狼，它们就不会再纠缠我的线了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is drying fish in Raviol Forest.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以来找我，或者向正在罗比奥森林晾鱼的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[渔夫]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>报告。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Good. An order for fish cake just came in.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
很好。刚好收到了一份鱼糕的订单。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We didn't get orders for this menu that often, so It's strange that there's so many requests. Did the word spread finally that It's good?
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我们很少接到这个菜单的订单，所以这么多请求很奇怪。难道终于有人传开了，说它很好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyhow, we're in a hurry down to the minute and seconds but that sleepyhead is probably sleeping again. So I hope that you, adventurer, can help us again.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
总之，我们分秒必争，但那个瞌睡鬼大概又在睡觉了。所以希望冒险者你能再次帮帮我们。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please bring five mushroom spores and catch ten Trans Spores.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
请带五个香菇芽孢，并抓住十只变形蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is dozing off in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
完成后你可以来找我，或者向正在森林里打瞌睡的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>报告。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today won't be boring? I wonder who'll visit me today. Who is it?
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天不会无聊吧？不知道今天谁会来找我呢。是谁呀？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is anybody here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有人在吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Ah! You're here. Come in. This is a magical place of miraculous elderly lady. It's a shrine.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
啊！你来了。请进。这里是奇迹老奶奶的魔法之地。这是一个神龛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Elderly lady? She doesn't look like one. Like a very... young doram.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老奶奶？她看起来不像啊。看起来非常...年轻的多兰。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Not me!
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
不是我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who else?

[Shaman meow]
Grandma will be sad to hear that. This world is full of things that exist but cannot be seen. For instance, Let's talk about your case.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
老奶奶听到这话会伤心的。这个世界上有很多存在但看不见的东西。比如，让我们谈谈你的情况。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Before the discovery of the new world, we dorams thought that Lasagna was the end of the world. The new world was invisible and so were the countless people who lived there.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
在新世界被发现之前，我们多兰认为罗札纳就是世界的尽头。新世界是看不见的，生活在那里的无数人也是看不见的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But didn't the new world and human really exist?
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
但新世界和人类不是真的存在吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I get what you're saying.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白你的意思了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
So what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
那么，是什么让你来到这里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a sufferer and I'm here for that person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有一位受害者，我是为了那个人而来的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
What pain is that? If grandma and I can take care of it, we will. One shouldn't turn away from a sufferer.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
那是怎样的痛苦？如果老奶奶和我能解决，我们一定会帮忙的。面对受苦的人，不应该袖手旁观。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, he's in denial but I think he's been possessed by an evil spirit. He opened a sealed jar on an uninhabited island.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，他本人还在否认，但我认为他被邪恶的精灵附身了。他在一个无人岛上打开了一个封印的罐子。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh my. Who would've thought that there would be another idiot like the ^0000cdboatswain of Con-Chliina^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
天哪。谁能想到竟然还有像^0000cd康-奇利纳的水手长^000000那样的笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh, that boatswain is the person who had asked for my help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，那位水手长就是请求我帮忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Indeed, who else would do such an idiotic thing? I can't help him, so please leave.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
确实，除了他还有谁会做这种蠢事？我帮不了他，请离开吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there really no way to help him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的没有办法帮他吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Those evil spirits usually try to take over the host by absorbing his energy and leave when he dies. For some reason, they can't take over the host's body.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
那些邪恶的精灵通常会通过吸收宿主的能量来试图夺取身体，并在宿主死后离开。出于某种原因，它们无法完全占据宿主的身体。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
So they move on to another person nearby. That's why when the host dies, it is specially sealed in a jar by a shaman and discarded in a place where no one can find it.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
所以它们会转移到附近的其他人身上。这就是为什么当宿主死后，萨满会将其特别封印在罐子里，并丢弃在无人能找到的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But if someone opens the jar, those evil spirits cling onto that idiot and repeat the same process. there's no way to detach them until the host dies. In other words, there's no solution that would make the boatswain happy.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
但如果有人打开了罐子，那些邪恶的精灵就会附着在那个笨蛋身上，重复同样的过程。在宿主死亡之前，没有办法将它们分离。换句话说，没有能让水手长满意的解决方案。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
When I told him that ��a noble person from a new place solves the problem,�� I meant that the problem will move onto ^0000cda new person^000000. Seems like he misunderstood me and sent you.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
当我告诉他“来自新地方的高贵之人会解决这个问题”时，我的意思是问题会转移到^0000cd一个新的人^000000身上。看来他误解了我的意思，派你来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
T-then, you've also...

[Shaman meow]
I opened the jar. It was an unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
是我打开了罐子。那是不幸的意外。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I-I don't mean that I dislike grandma. Yes, yes. I'll be careful.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
我...我不是说我不喜欢老奶奶。是的，是的。我会小心的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Anyway, the boatswain has no choice. Live rest of his life, tormented, or become a shaman cat and live somewhat comfortably. Life of a shaman cat Isn't so bad.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
总之，水手长别无选择。要么带着痛苦度过余生，要么成为萨满猫，过上相对舒适的生活。萨满猫的生活其实还不错。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Those with much knowledge have a bit more options.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
知识渊博的人会有更多的选择。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
If he chooses not to become a shaman meow, then he must live every day ^0000cddependent on a new talisman^000000. But if he chooses to become a shaman meow, then tell him to come see me.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
如果他选择不成为萨满喵，那么他必须每天^0000cd依赖新的护符^000000。但如果他选择成为萨满喵，请让他来见我。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But becoming a shaman meow will be better in many ways. Evil spirits will wear him down more and more to take over his body.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
但成为萨满喵在很多方面会更好。邪恶的精灵会不断削弱他，试图夺取他的身体。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I heard that the boatswain had visited previous shaman meow with Captain Gamberry in the past. But he stormed out in the middle of explanation and never came back.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
我听说水手长以前曾拜访过甘贝里船长身边的前任萨满喵。但他在解释进行到一半时怒气冲冲地离开了，之后再也没回来过。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
He should be counting his days by now after suffering so much.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
经历了这么多苦难，他现在应该是在倒数着日子过吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not really. He seemed really energetic.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
倒也不是。他看起来精力很充沛。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I guess not everyone has what it takes to become the boatswain of Con-Chliina. How did he survive all this time?
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
看来并不是每个人都有资格成为康奇利纳号的水手长。他是怎么撑到现在的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... He seems to be living off on one superstition to another. Like dolls and salts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...他似乎靠着一个又一个迷信活着。比如布偶和盐。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh my, he really is an idiot. Had he come to me earlier, I would have told him about a less painful path.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
天哪，他真是个笨蛋。如果他早点来找我，我本可以告诉他一条不那么痛苦的路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At any rate, if he must depend on a new talisman every day, what's today's talisman? I'm sure the boatswain needs some time to think things over, so until then, he'll need talisman.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，如果他必须每天依赖新的护符，那今天的护符是什么？我相信水手长需要时间考虑，在那之前，他需要护符。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman... Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天的护符...让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh, that? Really? Ooh, That's awful... Seriously, how would that...ugh.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
哦，那个？真的吗？噢，那太糟糕了...说真的，那要怎么...啧。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Tie them firmly and carry them around. Then he'll be safe today.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天的护符是^0000cd20个罗勒和5个罗勒锁^000000。把它们系紧并随身携带。这样他今天就会安全了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Basil and basil lock?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
罗勒和罗勒锁？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
They both are obtained from those dirty ^0000cdbasilisks^000000. Basilisks received energy from Lord Imuk that lived over 2,000 years, so evil spirits can't stand even being near a piece of them.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
它们都来自那些肮脏的^0000cd蛇怪^000000。蛇怪接收了伊穆克大人2000多年前留下的能量，所以邪恶的精灵连靠近它们的一小部分都受不了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But they really are way too filthy. I bet the boatswain will ask you for a favor since he won't want to catch one with his own hands.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
但它们实在太脏了。我打赌水手长会求你帮忙，因为他肯定不想亲手去抓。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. I'll tell him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。我会告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Then see you again soon.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
那我们很快再见。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Make sure you deliver my message to the boatswain. And today's talisman is 20 basils and 5 basil locks.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
记得把我的话转告给水手长。今天的护符是20个罗勒和5个罗勒锁。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basil locks^000000. You'll get your hands very dirty today. I'm sorry. But grandma has spoken so That's the bottom line.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天的护符是^0000cd20个罗勒锁^000000。今天你的手会很脏。我很抱歉。但老奶奶已经发话了，这就是底线。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd5 basil locks and 1 holy water^000000. In the new world, the holy water drives the evil spirits away. It must've worked when the boatswain came in contact with the people of the new world.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天的护符是^0000cd5个罗勒锁和1瓶圣水^000000。在新世界，圣水能驱赶邪恶的精灵。当水手长接触新世界的人时，这肯定起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Same as the first. The most basic is the most useful.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
今天的护符是^0000cd20个罗勒和5个罗勒锁^000000。和第一次一样。最基础的往往最有用。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
That thing clinging onto the boatswain is also a doram. It especially hates basil locks. That is the reason why basil locks are used.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
附着在水手长身上的那个东西也是多兰。它特别讨厌罗勒锁。这就是使用罗勒锁的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I pray for your peace and safety. Tell the boatswain to come back anytime he changes his mind.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
我为您祈祷平安。请告诉水手长，如果他改变主意，随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
The boatswain must've sent you. I'll tell you about the talisman that'll help you get through today safely.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
一定是水手长派你来的吧。我会告诉你今天能保你平安的护符。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Where... yes, yeah... today is that one? Got it.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
哪里...是的，没错...今天是那个日子吗？明白了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I'll tell you today's talisman. It is...
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
我来告诉你今天的护符。它是...

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
^0000cd20 basil locks^000000. You'll get your hands very dirty today. I'm sorry. But grandma has spoken so That's the bottom line.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
^0000cd20个罗勒锁^000000。今天你的手会很脏。我很抱歉。但老奶奶已经发话了，这就是底线。

scripts.text: [Shaman meow]
scripts.translation: [萨满喵]

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
^0000cd5 basil locks and 1 holy water^000000. In the new world, the holy water drives the evil spirits away. It must've worked when the boatswain came in contact with the people of the new world.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]

^0000cd20个罗勒和5个罗勒锁^000000。和第一次一样。最基础的往往最有用。

I pray for your peace and safety. Tell the boatswain to come back anytime he changes his mind.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
我为您祈祷平安。请告诉水手长，如果他改变主意，随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
You want to know the future? The past? If you know where you're standing, then you can see the past, future, everything.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
你想看未来？还是过去？如果你知道自己在哪，就能看到过去、未来，以及一切。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
If you need to curse someone, break a curse, or need a bit of luck, then come see me.
scripts.translation:
[萨满喵]
如果你需要诅咒某人、解除诅咒，或者需要一点运气，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Hello.
The weather is good today, isn't it?
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
你好。
今天天气真好，不是吗？
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Talk about the weather.
scripts.translation: 聊聊天气

scripts.text: Ask about the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 询问关于义警的事

scripts.text: Ask about Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 询问关于罗札纳的事

scripts.text: End dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
In Lasagna, a fresh sea breeze always tickle your whiskers.
And thanks to this moist air, our cheese ripen deliciously.
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
在罗札纳，清新的海风总是轻抚着你的胡须。
多亏了这湿润的空气，我们的奶酪才能熟得如此美味。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Oh! You haven't met our chief yet?
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
哦！你还没见过我们的首领吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Hmm...
I think it'd be best for you to see the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
嗯...
我想你最好先去找首领。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
He should be at the Adventurers' Club around now...
The Adventurers' Club is to the east from here, so it shouldn't be difficult to find.
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
他应该就在附近的冒险者俱乐部...
冒险者俱乐部在从这里往东的方向，应该不难找到。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
The Vigilante Corp not only maintain public order in the town, but also play the main role in running the town.
Maybe our chief should be called the mayor instead.
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
义警公司不仅维护城镇的公共秩序，还在城镇管理中扮演主要角色。
也许我们的首领应该被称为市长才对。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Lasagna is a port town located at the end of the Far-Star continent.
it's a small but a thriving town thanks to the efforts of Chief Peperoncino, Captain Gamberi, and Captain Tomatomas!
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
罗札纳是位于法尔斯塔大陆尽头的港口城镇。
多亏了首领 佩佩龙奇诺、船长 甘贝里和船长 番茄马斯的努力，这里虽然规模不大，却十分繁荣！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[义警向导]
再见。

scripts.text:
Yo!
Heya!
scripts.translation:
哟！
嗨！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
He is Chief Peperoncino, the boss of the Vigilante Corp!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
他是首领 佩佩龙奇诺，义警公司的老板！

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您的物品栏已满。 -
- 这意味着您无法再接收任何物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yo!
If you need anything, just say the word!
I'll help you with what I can!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
哟！
如果你有什么需要，尽管开口！
我会尽力帮你的！

scripts.text: Ask about the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 询问关于义警的事

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Let me tell you something about our Vigilante Corp!
You can say that we play a key role in this town!
All the young Doram want to join us too!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
让我告诉你一些关于我们义警公司的事！
可以说我们在这个城镇中扮演着关键角色！
所有年轻的多兰都想加入我们！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
The Vigilante haven't been around for long, but Lasagna was a failing town before we showed up and it's thanks to us that the town is thriving now!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
义警公司成立的时间不长，但在我们出现之前，罗札纳还是个衰败的城镇，多亏了我们，现在才变得繁荣起来！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
When I was a kid, it was so... so tough around here...
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
我小时候，这里的日子...真是...太难熬了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
There were none of these savory and comfy streets of cheese... Instead, we had mushy anchovy guts... everywhere you go...
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
那时候没有这些美味又舒适的奶酪街道...到处都是软烂的鳀鱼内脏...走到哪里都是...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
And don't talk about the smell...
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
更别提那股味道了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
...
...
......

[Vigilante Olio]
Anyway! Enough of the depressing stuff!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
总之！别想那些令人沮丧的事了！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
The future looked bleak for Lasagna, but they discussed and decided that Chief Peperoncino would take charge of the Vigilante to protect the town, while the captains Gamberi and Tomatomas lead the merchant band.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
罗札纳的未来曾一度黯淡无光，但经过讨论，大家决定由首领 佩佩龙奇诺领导义警公司来保护城镇，而船长 甘贝里和船长 番茄马斯则领导商队。

scripts.text: Ask about merchant band.
scripts.translation: 询问关于商队的事

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Well... I don't know much about the merchant band!
But I heard that it was started with the little seed money pooled by the three leaders, and now it has grown into a huge organization that makes most of this town's income.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
嗯...我对商队的事了解不多！
但我听说，它最初是由三位领袖凑集的一点启动资金开始的，现在已经发展成一个庞大的组织，为这个城镇带来了大部分收入。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
In the beginning, they only had a single trading ship that leaked and was half sinking.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
起初，他们只有一艘漏水、快要沉没的贸易船。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
But now, they have a massive fleet!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
但现在，他们拥有了一支庞大的舰队！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
A few years ago, Captain Tomatomas embarked on a journey to discover a new trading route, but he went missing when his ship was caught up in a storm.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
几年前，船长 番茄马斯为了探索新的贸易路线而出发，但他的船在途中遭遇风暴，他因此失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
It was terrible back then!
Even our chief and Captain Gamberi had lost their calm.
They dropped everything and put all their efforts into finding Captain Tomatomas.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
那时候真是糟糕透了！
连我们的首领和船长 甘贝里都失去了冷静。
他们放下手头的一切，全力寻找船长 番茄马斯。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
And...
Their efforts finally paid off, as Captain Tomatomas was recently found on an island called Malangdo off the coast of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
然后...
他们的努力终于有了回报，船长 番茄马斯最近被发现在米德加尔特海岸外的一座名为马拉恩多的岛上。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
On top of that, they also discovered a new sea route to the continent of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
除此之外，他们还发现了一条通往米德加尔特大陆的新航线！

scripts.text: Ask about reaching the continent of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 询问如何前往米德加尔特大陆

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
From here, the Con-Chliina is the only ship that can reach Midgard. So the only people who can board the ship are the Con-Chliina's sailors and members of the Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
从这里出发，只有“康奇利纳号”能抵达米德加尔特。所以只有康奇利纳号的水手和义警成员才能登船。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Huh? aren't you from Midgard?
How did you get here in the first place?
can't you just go back the same way you came here?
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
咦？你不是米德加尔特人吗？
那你一开始是怎么来到这里的？
难道不能原路返回吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Because of that, even people from other towns are flooding in to join the Vigilante and because of that, we had to turn a sentry post in the southern part of the Ravioli Plain into a waiting area.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
正因如此，连其他城镇的人都蜂拥而来想要加入义警，所以我们不得不把拉维奥利平原南部的哨站改成了候船区。

scripts.text: Ask about joining the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 询问如何加入义警

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Huh?
you're interested too?
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
咦？
你也感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
No surprise there!
The Doram are nothing if not curious!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
这并不奇怪！
多兰人可是出了名的好奇心旺盛！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
You need the chief's permission to join the Vigilante, so you'd better ask him.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
加入义警需要首领的许可，所以你最好去问问他。

scripts.text: Ask about boarding the Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation: 询问如何登上康奇利纳号

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Hmm...
I don't really know myself!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
嗯...
我自己也不太清楚！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
What can people from Midgard do...?
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
米德加尔特的人能做什么呢...？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Go talk to the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
先去和首领谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
You need the chief's permission to join the Vigilante, so you'd better ask him.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
加入义警需要首领的许可，所以你最好去问问他。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Hmm...
I don't really know myself!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
嗯...
我自己也不太清楚！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
What can people from Midgard do...?
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
米德加尔特的人能做什么呢...？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Go talk to the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
先去和首领谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yo!
If you need anything, just say the word!
I'll help you with what I can!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
哟！
如果你有什么需要，尽管开口！
我会尽力帮你的！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Nice to meet you.
I'm Chief Peperoncino of the Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
幸会。
我是义警组织的首领，佩佩龙奇诺。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This is of little importance...
But did our vigilante member at the town's central plaza tell you something?
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
这没什么大不了的...
不过，城镇广场上的义警成员有没有告诉你什么？

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Is it your first time here?
With the discovery of the new sea route, we've had a sudden influx of foreigners visiting our town...
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
你是第一次来这里吗？
随着新航线的发现，最近突然涌入了许多外国游客...

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Hmm...
In any case, please enjoy your stay and don't cause any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
嗯...
总之，请在这里玩得开心，不要惹事生非。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Olio!
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
奥利奥！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yes, Chief!!!
scripts.translation:
[义警 奥利奥]
是，首领！！！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
If you need anything, talk to Olio here.
I've urgent matters to take care of and will take my leave.
Later, then.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
如果你需要什么，就找这里的奥利奥。
我有急事要处理，先走了。
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
If you need anything, talk to Olio here.
I've urgent matters to take care of and will take my leave.
Later, then.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
如果你需要什么，就找这里的奥利奥。
我有急事要处理，先走了。

What is it?

[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
With the way things are, you only need to pass a simple test if you want to join the Vigilante and take part in the 'Midgard Expedition'.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]

But I'm a bit busy with urgent matters to give you the test now, so perhaps later...
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Hmm...
No, wait!
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
嗯...
不，等等！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
请跟我来，这边。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This way, please.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
请这边走。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
There was Jindou's intervention, but I didn't think you'd complete the first test so easily...
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
We'll move right on to the next test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
我们直接进行下一个测试。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This time, Tali at the northwestern tip of Lasagna will give you a hand.
Go see her.

[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
这次，罗札纳西北角的塔莉会协助你。

I'd rather not be picky with the young people who are raring to go on an adventure, so this should be enough.
scripts.translation:

Alright, congratulations on becoming a member of the Vigilante Corp.
The new adventures are yours to challenge.
scripts.translation:

But there were too many things here that I had to protect...
scripts.translation:

you're as dependable as ever.

scripts.translation:
