曾传闻在风暴中失踪，但后来发现它安全抵达并在新世界建立了据点。消息传开后，蝴蝶号作为冒险和英雄的代名词而广为人知。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Abbreviation of Lasagna Day. It is the day when Butterfly, safely arrived in the new world, was found through the discovery of a new sea route after 32 search attempts.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
罗札纳日的缩写。在尝试了32次寻找新航线后，蝴蝶号被发现在新世界安全抵达的那一天。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Lasagna celebrates this day annually with magnificent fireworks and festivals.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
罗札纳每年都在这一天举行盛大的烟花表演和庆典。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing to see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没什么可看的。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
看起来数量很多，体积也很大。要不要砍掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
玩偶，确认。
铃铛，确认。
干制星百合，确认。
绳子打了33个结，确认。
帆上有5道褶皱，确认。很好！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
什么！是谁弄断了这根柳树枝！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，这次即将开始新的冒险。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哦，你就是那位即将前往新大陆冒险的新晋冒险者。我很欣赏这种冒险精神。我年轻时也曾四处游历。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什么时候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不久之前。感觉就像昨天发生的一样。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你还在半夜的甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哎呀，真是胡言乱语。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
嘿，我知道了。那里太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
副厨师长在起航前总是处于紧张状态。别往心里去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多兰不会计较这些小事。你可以走了。我们要出发了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is almost the time for us to sail off. You should go back.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
快要出发了。你应该回去了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
玩偶，确认。
铃铛，确认。
干制星百合，确认。
绳子打了33个结，确认。
帆上有5道褶皱，确认。很好！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
玩偶，确认。
铃铛，确认。
干制星百合，确认。
绳子打了33个结，确认。
帆上有5道褶皱，确认。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
什么！是谁弄断了这根柳树枝！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be in trouble. What is the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来遇到了麻烦。怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You don't seem to be experienced enough to resolve my problem. Come back after gaining more experience.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你看起来经验不足，无法解决我的问题。等你获得更多经验后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
We need to take off anytime soon, and the preparation for sailing is not made properly.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我们随时都要出发了，但航行准备工作还没有做好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know much about sailing, but none of those sounds relevant to the ship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我对航海不太懂，但这些东西听起来都和船没关系啊。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is not your business... Well, ^0000cda stranger from a new place is supposed to solve this problem^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
这不是你的事... 唉，^0000cd来自新地方的陌生人，就该来解决这种问题^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I am the sailor of sailors. The real seaman. I am the boatswain of this ship who is in charge of taking care of tough sailors and all the business on the deck. The story I am about to tell you... You shouldn't tell it to anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我是水手中的水手，真正的海员。我是这艘船的水手长，负责管理那些难搞的水手和甲板上的所有事务。我要告诉你的故事... 你可不能告诉别人。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Then you would learn how fearful a sailor can be.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那样你就会知道，水手其实有多胆小。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I won't listen.
scripts.translation: 不听

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Then go back to your spot. You shouldn't expect any favors from me from now on.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那就回你的位置去。从现在起，别指望我会给你任何好处。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Good. I like the attitude that you don't give in for threats. So do I. Well, so did I.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
很好。我喜欢你不屈服于威胁的态度。我也是。嗯，以前也是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why do you use a past tense?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么用过去式？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Do you believe in invisible things? Like those which don't really exist? Especially the special ones that appear in the night...
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你相信看不见的东西吗？比如那些并不真正存在的东西？尤其是那些在夜晚出现的特别的东西...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, the dead.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你是说死人。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You are right. I had no fear. I enjoyed running into adventures and stuff. That's how I ended up in Lasagna and became the boatswain of Con-Chliina after meeting Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你说得对。我以前并不害怕。我喜欢冒险之类的。就是这样，我来到了罗札纳，遇到了船长 甘贝里，成为了康克莉娜号的水手长。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I have been to everywhere. And one day, I found it.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我去过很多地方。然后有一天，我发现了它。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
There are numerous islands on the sea where no one lives. Sometimes, you find a pot buried in the middle of an island.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
海上有许多无人居住的小岛。有时候，你会在岛的中间发现一个埋着的罐子。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
When the ship was anchored in an unknown island to replenish water, I explored the island as I always did. And I found a ^0000cdsealed pot^000000 there.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
当船停泊在一个未知的小岛补充淡水时，我像往常一样探索了这座岛。然后我在那里发现了一个^0000cd封印的罐子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I shook it, but there was no sound. I was wondering what was in there making no sound when it had been sealed so carefully.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我摇了摇它，但没有声音。我很奇怪，既然封得这么严实，里面是什么东西才会一点声音都没有。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Gamberi who came there tried to stop me, but I opened the seal. There was nothing in the ^0000cdpot^000000, and nothing happened.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
赶来的甘贝里试图阻止我，但我还是打开了封印。^0000cd罐子^000000里什么都没有，什么也没发生。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I threw away the pot and got on Con-Chliina. And it happened that night.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我扔掉了罐子，回到了康克莉娜号。然后，那天晚上，事情发生了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I guess we are getting into the good part. I really like it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，看来要进入精彩的部分了。我很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Oh the night, I listened to this song. I could hear it anywhere. I could hear is from the creases in my palm, near my ear and the silver waves.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那天晚上，我听到了这首歌。我在任何地方都能听到。我能从掌心的褶皱、耳边以及银色的波浪中听到它。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It felt like I could grab the tune with my hand. When I was walking, following the sound, someone shook me hard. The next thing I noticed was that I was being held by the crews just before jumping off the ship.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我感觉我可以用手抓住那个旋律。当我跟着声音走的时候，有人用力摇我。等我回过神来，发现自己正被船员们抓住，差点就要跳下船了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Enchanted by the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被那首歌迷住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I thought so. I went to sleep with my ears closed. The strange thing is that it happened again the next day and the day after.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我也这么觉得。我捂着耳朵睡着了。奇怪的是，第二天和第三天又发生了同样的事。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Every night, I saw a dim silhouette or couldn't fall asleep because of the chattering noise in my ear. When I did fall asleep, I felt this weight on my body and woke up, covered in cold sweats.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
每天晚上，我都能看到模糊的身影，或者因为耳边嘈杂的声音而无法入睡。即使睡着了，我也感觉身上压着什么东西，醒来时浑身冷汗。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The pot turned out to be a pot in which an evil ghost has been sealed. Gamberi knew it and tried to stop me. However, it was too late. I had already broken the seal. I grew up in the land, and did not know about that at all.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那个罐子原来封印着一个恶灵。甘贝里知道这一点，所以试图阻止我。但已经太迟了，我已经打破了封印。我在内陆长大，对此一无所知。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I have been suffering from ^0000cdthe supernatural phenomenon^000000 ever since.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
从那以后，我就一直遭受^0000cd超自然现象^000000的折磨。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean whatever in there has cursed you, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是说里面的东西诅咒了你，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Gamberi took me to the Shaman meow to get a counselling, but it didn't work. This evil ghost is too old, strong and possessive to be removed.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
甘贝里带我去找萨满喵咨询，但没用。这个恶灵太古老、太强大了，而且占有欲极强，无法被驱除。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The only thing I could do was to weaken it as much as possible each day.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我能做的唯一事情，就是每天尽可能削弱它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is depending on all kinds of superstitions the way to weaken it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
靠各种迷信来削弱它？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No other crews of Con-Chliina, except Captain Gamberi and I, know about this.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
除了船长甘贝里和我，康克莉娜号上没有其他船员知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The ^0000cdShaman meow^000000 has told me a riddle that a stranger from a new place will solve this problem. It is not a coincidence that we have met.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
^0000cd萨满喵^000000告诉我一个谜题，说来自新地方的陌生人会解决这个问题。我们相遇并非巧合。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Please go and tell this story to the Shaman meow and bring me the remedy. I'll do anything for you if you get rid of it.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
请去把这个故事告诉萨满喵，并带给我解药。如果你能除掉它，我会为你做任何事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anything? Is that a promise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
任何事？这是承诺吗？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Boatswain of Con-Chliina doesn't lie. If you don't trust me, you should trust Gamberi who has hired me as the Boatswain of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
康克莉娜号的水手长从不撒谎。如果你不信任我，你应该信任雇用我担任康克莉娜号水手长的甘贝里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Shaman meow lives in a secluded place near the entrance of the village.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
萨满喵住在村庄入口附近一个偏僻的地方。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Shaman meow is living in a secluded place at the entrance of Lasagna. I hope that a stranger from a new place like you take care of my problem.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
萨满喵住在罗札纳入口附近一个偏僻的地方。我希望像您这样来自新地方的陌生人能解决我的问题。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Dear adventurer, did you meet Shaman meow?
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
亲爱的冒险者，您见到萨满喵了吗？

scripts.text: [You told the Boatswain the story you had heard from Shaman meow.]
scripts.translation: [你把从萨满喵那里听来的故事告诉了水手长。]

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What? I should become a Shaman meow? What a nonsense! I am a sailor! I shall die on the sea as a sailor!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
什么？我要变成萨满喵？真是胡扯！我是水手！我要作为水手死在海上！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'd rather spend the rest of life fighting than living with the ghosts!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我宁愿在战斗中度过余生，也不愿和幽灵们待在一起！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shaman meow is not as bad as you think. Why don't you go get a counseling when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
萨满喵并没有您想的那么坏。您有空的时候，不妨去寻求一下咨询。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'll just pretend you didn't say that! I don't give a damn about a Shaman meow saying those malicious things!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我就当您没说过这话！我才不在乎萨满喵说的那些恶毒的话！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The evil ghost will absorb the life out of you. You won't last many days like this, dear Boatswain.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
邪恶的幽灵会吸干您的生命。亲爱的水手长，您这样撑不了几天了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What? Wait... That is...
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
什么？等等...那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can survive through a day with a ^0000cddaily amulet^000000. I guess you should be closer to the Shaman meow now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您可以靠^0000cd每日护符^000000撑过一天。我想您现在应该离萨满喵更近了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
......

[{0}]
And today's amulet is ^0000cd20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks^000000. You can get them from the basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
今天的护符是^0000cd20个巴希尔和5个巴希尔岩^000000。您可以从巴希尔那里获得它们。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Ba... Basilisks... Out of the frying pan into the fire. I don't like to deal with those dirty things.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
巴...巴希尔...真是屋漏偏逢连夜雨。我不喜欢和那些脏东西打交道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, That's it from me. I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，我说完了。我该走了...

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Yeah, the stranger taking care of this problem. It must have been our destiny.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
是啊，这个解决麻烦的陌生人。这一定是我们的命运。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, it meant that you would die and the evil ghost would find a new host.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，那意味着您会死，而邪恶的幽灵会找到新的宿主。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No, no, never. You cannot get out of this like that. ^0000cdIt must have been our destiny.^000000 It is a fate! You should help me.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不，不，绝不。您不能就这样逃脱。^0000cd这一定是我们的命运。^000000这是命运！您应该帮助我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Well, just as I heard from Shaman meow. I was told that the Boatswain would make me do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好吧，正如我从萨满喵那里听说的那样。我被告知水手长会让我这么做。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
That Shaman meow sure seems to have the vision. I am a believer now. I believe the amulet is really effective. Please go get me one now. Please.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那个萨满喵似乎真有远见。我现在是个信徒了。我相信护符真的有效。请现在去给我弄一个。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I can't help it. Just for today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我没办法。就今天这一次。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Today's amulet is 20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks! The sun will go down anytime soon!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
今天的护符是20个巴希尔和5个巴希尔岩！太阳马上就要落山了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here are the Basil and Basilrock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是巴希尔和巴希尔岩。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Argh... Give it to me. No, no. Not like that. Just wrap it a little so that no one can see. Right. Like that. Give me all you have.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
啊...给我。不，不。不是那样。稍微包一下，别让任何人看到。对，就这样。把你所有的都给我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is difficult.

[Boatswain]
This... This is...
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
这...这是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like the black fog neat me is lifting! I don't hear the whispering sound anymore! My head feels so clear in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
感觉我身边的黑雾正在消散！我再也听不到那些低语声了！我的头脑很久没有这么清醒过了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is unfair that I haven't known about this method so far!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
竟然到现在才知道这种方法，真是太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It only lasts a day. When it expires, it will be burnt up. I guess you should be close to Shaman meow from now on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它只能维持一天。过期后就会烧毁。我想你以后应该多亲近萨满喵。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No, never. I don't intend to be friends with Shaman meow or hunt the basilisks myself.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不，绝不。我不打算和萨满喵做朋友，也不打算自己去猎杀巴希尔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you going to do then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你打算怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Well, don't I have the ^0000cdnew helper^000000 in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
嗯，我面前不是有^0000cd新助手^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I knew it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I will reward you handsomely. However, you haven't been able to solve the problem permanently so I don't have to keep the promise I have made.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我会好好报答你的。不过，既然你没有彻底解决这个问题，我就不必遵守之前的承诺了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is unfair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这太不公平了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I will reward you handsomely. Please do me another favor tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
我会好好报答你的。明天请再帮我一个忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We will see. I'll come back if I want to.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再说吧。如果我想来，我会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Oh, you would come. I have a hunch.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哦，你会来的。我有预感。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am pretty sure that it is the evil ghost talking to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很确定那是邪恶的幽灵在和你说话。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'll let it slide since you have done me a favor. I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
既然你帮了我，我就既往不咎了。明天见。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Did you bring the amulet for today? You seem to be empty-handed. Is there anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你带今天的护符了吗？看起来你两手空空。出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Please give it to me now. I feel the power of the amulet fading away now.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
请现在把它给我。我感觉护符的力量正在消退。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
This is the amulet for today! Give me all the Basilrocks you have.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
这是今天的护符！把你所有的巴希尔岩都给我。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like watching the blue horizon on a clear and windless day. It is refreshing.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
就像在晴朗无风的日子看着蓝色的地平线一样。真令人神清气爽。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like watching the clouds go by lying on my back on a green hill.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
就像躺在绿色的山坡上，仰面看着云朵飘过一样。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like seeing the sunshine through the black fog.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
就像在漆黑的迷雾中看见阳光一样。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Thank you for getting them for me. Please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
谢谢你帮我拿到它们。明天请再来。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你说过，想来的时候就会来。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The amulet is still effective. Go to see Shamanyang after ^0000cd4:00 am^000000 and bring me tomorrow's amulet.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
护符仍然有效。在^0000cd凌晨4:00^000000之后去找萨玛尼扬，然后带明天的护符给我。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
你说过，想来的时候就会来。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
However, you shouldn't have come to me. You should have gone to ^0000cdShamanyang^000000 and asked about today's amulet.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不过，你不该来找我。你应该去找^0000cd萨玛尼扬^000000，询问今天的护符。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I am counting on you then.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
看起来又多又大。要不要砍掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
只要有风和帆，我们就能去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，这次即将开始新的冒险。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哦，你就是那位即将前往新大陆冒险的新晋冒险者。我很欣赏这种冒险精神。我年轻时也曾四处游历。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什么时候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不久之前。感觉就像昨天发生的一样。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你还在半夜的甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哎呀，真是胡言乱语。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
嘿，我知道了。那里太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
副厨师长在起航前总是处于紧张状态。别往心里去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多兰不会计较这些小事。你可以走了。我们要出发了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
The Sous Chef believes that it brings bad luck to have a stranger while cooking. You should go now.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
副厨师长认为，做饭时有陌生人在场会带来厄运。你现在应该走了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
只要有风和帆，我们就能去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[Cow]
Moo -
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
哞——

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Take your filthy hand off from her! [Woncow] is sensitive, so no one besides me can touch her!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
把你那脏手拿开！[元]很敏感，除了我，谁都不能碰她！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A cow's name is [Woncow]...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
奶牛的名字叫[元]...

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
So? What! I won her on a bet. Every time I call her name, it reminds me of that moment of victory. It's beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
那又怎样！我打赌赢来的。每次叫她的名字，都会让我想起那个胜利的时刻。这很美好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, why is there a cow on this ship?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，为什么这艘船上有头奶牛？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Why? Because we want to drink fresh milk every day!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
为什么？因为我们想每天喝新鲜牛奶！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You brought a cow on board for fresh milk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为了喝新鲜牛奶，把奶牛带上船了？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
The boatswain can't leave her side for a second because she's his goddess of fortune. Lucky for us, we can have kaluna milk every day.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
水手长一刻都离不开她，因为她是他的幸运女神。幸运的是，我们每天都能喝到卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Hey! Keep talking and you'll jinx it!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
嘿！再这么说下去，你会带来厄运的！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
*Snore*
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
*呼噜*

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
看起来很多也很大。要不要切掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
快该吃饭了。我得加快速度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，这次即将开始新的冒险。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哦，你就是那位即将前往新大陆冒险的新晋冒险者。我很欣赏这种冒险精神。我年轻时也曾四处游历。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什么时候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
不久之前。感觉就像昨天发生的一样。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你还在半夜的甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哎呀，真是胡言乱语。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
嘿，我知道了。那里太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
副厨师长在起航前总是处于紧张状态。别往心里去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多兰不会计较这些小事。你可以走了。我们要出发了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Ask the Purser when the sailing sign will be issued. Depending on the time, we need to either change the ingredients or replenish them.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
去问问事务长什么时候发出起航信号。根据时间不同，我们需要更换或补充食材。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dear Sous Chef.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
亲爱的副厨师长。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Keep it short. I am busy.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
长话短说。我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean, ^0000cdhere comes the newbie!^000000

[Sous Chef]
What are you doing? Is it a new way to get yourself killed? I am not afraid of challenges. Draw your weapon.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你在干什么？这是新的自杀方式吗？我不怕挑战。拔出你的武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't mean.... I don't mean... That...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是那个意思... 我不是... 那个...

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You tiny rat! Now tell me. I don't think a rookie like you would come up with this on your own. Who sent you here?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你这只小老鼠！现在告诉我。我不认为像你这样的新人会自己想到这个。是谁派你来的？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Sous Chef! I think this guy's telling the truth. It is ordered by you, right?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
副厨师长！我觉得这家伙说的是实话。是你下的命令，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cdKahlugnag^000000? That Eggring! He made this newbie do this and pull off a prank! Hey, I am sorry. Please accept my apology.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd卡鲁纳^000000？那个蛋黄波利！是他让这新人这么做，搞恶作剧的！嘿，对不起。请接受我的道歉。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'll make sure to tell him to say sorry to you. He is such a trouble. He will always be nothing but a sailor boy.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我会让他向你道歉的。他真让人头疼。他永远只是个水手男孩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, never mind.

[Sous Chef]
Do you like ^0000cdfood^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你喜欢^0000cd食物^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! I do!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喜欢！我非常喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I mean making it, not eating it.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我是说制作，不是吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, I have never tried it, but I believe I would like it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我从来没试过，但我相信我会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
When you come back later, ^0000cdI'll teach you how to cook^000000. It is my way of saying sorry. Well, you may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
等你回来时，^0000cd我会教你怎么做菜^000000。这是我表达歉意的方式。好了，你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Hey newbie! Ask the Purser when we will be sailing off on your way. I think something has gone wrong since there is no sign so far.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
嘿，新人！离开时问问事务长我们什么时候起航。我觉得出问题了，因为目前还没有信号。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I will!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会的！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
快该吃饭了。我得加快速度。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Are you here to learn how to cook?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你是来学做饭的吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you want to learn how to cook, come to see me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你想学做饭，随时都可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You don't seem to be a novice anymore. I cannot teach you any further since I am too busy. If you want to explore the world of cooking more, you should find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你看起来已经不是初心者了。因为我太忙了，没法再教你更多了。如果你想更深入地探索烹饪的世界，应该去找别人。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I have heard that there is someone who teaches how to cook in the palace of the new continent. It would be a good idea to check out.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我听说在新大陆的宫殿里，有人教怎么做菜。去那里看看是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Good food can ^0000cdraise a certain status^000000 and ^0000cdrecover HP^000000. There is no reason not to cook and eat.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
美味的食物可以^0000cd提升特定状态^000000，并且^0000cd恢复HP^000000。没有理由不烹饪并享用它们。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are two main functions of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
烹饪有两个主要功能。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Firstly, it ^0000cdenhances status^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
首先，它^0000cd增强状态^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are six types of cooking. Each enhances ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex or Luk^000000. The amount of status enhancement depends on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
有六种类型的烹饪。每种分别增强^0000cd力量、敏捷、体质、智力、灵巧或幸运^000000。状态提升的幅度取决于烹饪等级。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Secondly, it ^0000cdrecovers HP and SP^000000. The amount of recovery also depends on the level of cooking, and some food only recovers HP.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
其次，它^0000cd恢复HP和SP^000000。恢复量也取决于烹饪等级，有些食物只恢复HP。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
In order to cook such dishes, you need to make some preparation.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
为了烹饪这样的菜肴，你需要做一些准备。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are two steps for the preparation.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
准备有两个步骤。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
First! You need a ^0000cdCookbook^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
第一！你需要一本^0000cd食谱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You need a Cookbook to learn how to prepare the ingredients and cook. You can get this Cookbook from a ^0000cdquest^000000 or a ^0000cdmonster^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你需要食谱来学习如何准备食材和烹饪。你可以从^0000cd任务^000000或^0000cd魔物^000000那里获得这本食谱。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Once you get a Cookbook, you need to collect the ^0000cdingredients^000000. It doesn't help to lick the pages if the Cookbook without preparing the ingredients. Even the eggrings know better than that.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
一旦你获得了食谱，就需要收集^0000cd食材^000000。如果不准备食材，舔食谱的页面是没用的。连蛋黄波利都比这更懂道理。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get the ingredients from the ^0000cdmonsters^000000 or the ^0000cdIngredient Merchants^000000. Although it takes quite a preparation to cook, the effectiveness is worth it.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从^0000cd魔物^000000或^0000cd食材商人^000000那里获得食材。虽然烹饪需要相当多的准备，但效果是值得的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Oh, by the way, you need to know that ^0000cdcooking may fail^000000. The chance of failure depends on the cooking utensils you have and the level of your cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
哦，顺便说一下，你需要知道^0000cd烹饪可能会失败^000000。失败几率取决于你拥有的烹饪工具和你的烹饪等级。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Well then, Let's start cooking. Talk to me again when you are ready!
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
好了，让我们开始烹饪吧。准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Let's see. Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
让我看看。你带齐所有食材了吗？

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副厨师长]

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
[Sous Chef]
Are you ready? Action speaks louder than words! Let's start cooking!
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你准备好了吗？行动胜于言语！让我们开始烹饪吧！

scripts.text: Go hunting after eating this. You won't believe the newfound power in you.
scripts.translation: 吃完这个再去打猎吧。你会相信自己体内涌动的全新力量。

scripts.text: If you eat this, you can move much faster than others. Even faster than a hummingbird flapping its wings.
scripts.translation: 吃了这个，你的移动速度会比别人快得多。甚至比蜂鸟扇动翅膀的速度还要快。

scripts.text: don't you feel the mysterious power pumping through your vessels already? You cannot resist it!
scripts.translation: 难道你还没感觉到那股神秘的力量在血管中奔涌吗？你无法抗拒它的！

scripts.text: You will become more skillful when you have a bite of this.
scripts.translation: 吃一点这个，你的技巧会变得更高超。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Are you ready? Action speaks louder than words! Let's start cooking!
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你准备好了吗？行动胜于言语！让我们开始烹饪吧！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Actually, you need the recipe and the cooking utensils, but it could be too complicated for a novice. I'll make one for you this time. We shouldn't waste the ingredients, you know.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
其实你需要食谱和烹饪工具，但这对于初心者来说可能太复杂了。这次我帮你做一份吧。我们可不能浪费食材，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Since it is a trial version for novice, it has the same effect as level 1 food, but ^0000cdit doesn't last as long.^000000
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
既然是给初学者的试用版，它的效果和1级食物一样，但^0000cd持续时间不会那么长。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What kind of food do you like to eat? Since Int or Luk dishes won't do much good for you, you can make four kinds of dishes for now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你喜欢吃什么？既然智力或幸运类料理对你没什么帮助，目前你可以制作四种料理。

scripts.text: Fragrant Seasoned Herbs
scripts.translation: 芳香调味香草

scripts.text: Crunchy Salad
scripts.translation: 脆爽沙拉

scripts.text: Mixed Stew
scripts.translation: 混合炖菜

scripts.text: Baked Gold Apple
scripts.translation: 烤金苹果

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cdFragrant Seasoned Herbs^000000. It enhances ^0000cdStr^000000. The people who use a lot of physical strength eat this.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd芳香调味香草^000000。它能提升^0000cd力量^000000。经常使用体力的人都会吃这个。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb and 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
食材是^0000cd1个三叶草、1个绿色药草和1个红色药草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Clovers and Red Herbs from Leaf Lunatic or Grass Fabre in the field outside.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以在外面的野外从群叶疯兔或草地绿棉虫身上获得三叶草和红色药草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Green Herbs from Grass Fabre.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从草地绿棉虫身上获得绿色药草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你带齐所有食材，我们就能烹饪了。快点吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The^0000cd Crunchy Salad^000000! I really like this dish. You have a good taste.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd脆爽沙拉^000000！我真的很喜欢这道菜。你的品味真好。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The Crunchy Salad enhances ^0000cdAgi^000000. The people who wants to attack faster or who doesn't want to get hit tend to eat it.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
脆爽沙拉能提升^0000cd敏捷^000000。想要攻击更快或者不想被击中的人通常会吃它。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
食材是^0000cd1个苹果和2个胡萝卜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Apples from the Eggring jumping in the outer field of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以在依斯鲁得岛外围的野外，从跳动的蛋黄波利身上获得苹果。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get the Carrots from Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从群叶疯兔身上获得胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook!
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你带齐所有食材，我们就能烹饪了！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ^0000cd Mixed Stew.^000000 It enhances ^0000cdVit^000000. It really fills you up so you don't feel mush pain even when you are hit by the monster.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd什锦炖菜^000000。它能提升^0000cdVIT^000000。吃了之后会非常饱腹，即使被魔物攻击也不会感到太多疼痛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy , 1 Fluff, and 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
食材是^0000cd1个杰勒比结晶、1个绒毛和1根羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Jellopies from the Eggring jumping in the outer field.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以在外围的野外，从跳动的蛋黄波利身上获得杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Fluffs from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从草地绿棉虫或群叶疯兔身上获得绒毛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Feathers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从草地绿棉虫或群叶疯兔身上获得羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你带齐所有食材，我们就能烹饪了。快点吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ^0000cdBaked Gold Apple^000000. It is hard to resist the golden hue on its surface.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd烤金苹果^000000。它表面那层金色的光泽让人难以抗拒。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It enhances ^0000cdDex^000000. The ones who'd like to raise the Hit tend to eat this.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
它能提升^0000cdDEX^000000。想要提高命中率的人通常会吃这个。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
食材是^0000cd1个苹果和1个三叶草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Apples from the Eggring in the outer field.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以在外围的野外，从蛋黄波利身上获得苹果。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Clovers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你可以从草地绿棉虫或群叶疯兔身上获得三叶草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你带齐所有食材，我们就能烹饪了。快点吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I need someone to ask a favor. You don't seem experienced enough.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我需要找人帮忙。你看起来经验还不够丰富。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... Are you from the new continent?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我说过不要那样进厨房的... 噢... 你是来自新大陆的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I see you around often these days. You look so strange. The face without any whiskers and the butt with no tail.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
最近经常看到你。你看起来很奇怪。脸上没有胡须，屁股上也没有尾巴。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Please excuse me. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
请多关照。我是负责这间厨房的副厨师长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am {1}.

[Sous Chef]
Your name is strange too.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你的名字也很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... You seem familiar...
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我说过不要那样进厨房的... 噢... 你看起来很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am an adventurer {1} who has set off on an adventure on Con-Killina.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是{1}，一名前往康基利纳冒险的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Is that so? Let me introduce myself. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
是吗？让我自我介绍一下。我是负责这间厨房的副厨师长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about the Head Chef? Why is the Sous Chef in charge of the kitchen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那主厨呢？为什么是副厨师长在管理厨房？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Look over there. The man sleeping on the floor who seems so far from being a gentleman. ^0000cdHe is our Head Chef^000000. The captain has always said how we have to do our best at what we do. But no use.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
看那边。那个睡在地板上、一点也不像绅士的男人。^0000cd他就是我们的主厨^000000。船长总是说我们要尽力做好自己的工作。但没用。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Do you know what is the most important thing in cooking? It is the endless passion and pursuit of the best taste. Nevertheless, our Head Chef has no interest in such things.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你知道烹饪最重要的是什么吗？是对最佳味道的无限热情和追求。然而，我们的主厨对此毫无兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
However, he is very good at making enough servings to feed a number of people in a short time. That is why he has become the Head Chef. But when people started complaining about the taste, I was called in.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
不过，他很擅长在短时间内做出足够多人的份数。这就是他成为主厨的原因。但当人们开始抱怨味道时，我就被叫来了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Ever since, the Head Chef entrusted me with everything.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
从那以后，主厨就把一切都托付给我了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I believe the people of the new continent eat different food from us. What do the people find delicious in the new continent?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我相信新大陆的人吃的食物和我们不同。新大陆的人觉得什么好吃？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to go out there and taste each dish. However, if I do, the crews of this ship will starve to death.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我想出去尝尝每一道菜。但是，如果我去了，这艘船的船员们就会饿死。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum, there are many kinds of food. We also hunt the ingredients and cook. There are many things for sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，有很多种食物。我们也打猎获取食材并烹饪。肯定有很多东西...

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I happen to have a ^0000cdCookbook of the new continent^000000. Do you have any of the ingredients for the food now?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我正好有一本^0000cd新大陆食谱^000000。你现在有这些食物的食材吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not really...

[Sous Chef]
Well, then let me ask you a favor. Please bring me some of the ingredients in this ^0000cdCookbook^000000. This thing called ^0000cdMastela Fruit Wine^000000... I am curious about this, but it requires some ingredients which are not found here.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
那么，请帮我一个忙。请带一些这本^0000cd食谱^000000里的食材给我。这个叫^0000cd玛丝黛拉果酒^000000的东西...我很好奇，但它需要一些这里找不到的食材。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
And please get me some ^0000cdCat Hardtacks made by the Head Chef of Navi^000000 as well. I have heard that it doesn't taste good, but it is nutritious and easy to store.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
另外，请帮我弄一些^0000cd由纳维主厨制作的猫干粮^000000。我听说它味道不好，但营养丰富且易于保存。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Please bring me ^0000cd4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtack^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
请带给我^0000cd4个玛丝黛拉果实和1个猫干粮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring them to me, I'll reward you handsomely.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果你把它们带给我，我会重重地奖励你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Well then. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
那么。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What happened to the favor I asked you. 4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtacks.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我拜托你的事怎么样了？4个玛丝黛拉果实和1个猫干粮。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You have brought them so fast. I can challenge making new cuisines with these. My heart is pounding so hard.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你来得真快。有了这些，我可以挑战制作新菜式了。我的心跳得好快。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
May I ask more favors next time? You know, the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
下次我可以再拜托你吗？你知道的，食材。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me drop by when I get time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有空的时候我会顺路过来。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你离开不久。已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cd20 Buns^000000. In order to keep them fresh, you should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
^0000cd20个馒头^000000。为了保持新鲜，请快点。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Oh, this is the Bun... It sure is hot and huge. This is totally different from that of our side.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
哦，这是馒头...真热，个头也很大。这和我们这边的完全不一样。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the food of Lasagna can take another step forward.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
谢谢你把它们带给我。多亏了你，罗札纳的美食能再进一步。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你离开不久。已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Bring ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
带^0000cd5个猫干粮和5个玛朗多罐头^000000。请快点。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Cat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food... Well, they will last long enough.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
猫干粮和玛朗多罐头...嗯，它们能保存很久。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you form getting them for me. Now Con-Chliina can come up with our own ways to store food for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
谢谢你帮我弄到它们。现在Con-Chliina可以研究出我们自己的长期保存食物的方法了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你离开不久。已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You should bring ^0000cd20 ice cubes^000000. It is to keep the stored food fresh. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
你应该带^0000cd20块冰块^000000。这是为了保持储存食物的新鲜。请快点。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ice cubes. I am just so excited to see them. The ice cubes that don't melt! It sure is the new continent.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
冰块。看到它们我真是太兴奋了。不会融化的冰块！这真是新大陆啊。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the crews of Con-Chliina can have some fresh food.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
谢谢你把它们带给我。多亏了你，Con-Chliina的船员们能吃到新鲜的食物了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What brought you here? Is it about the favor yesterday?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
什么事把你带到这里？是关于昨天拜托你的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Since I am on duty, I cannot proceed with any personal study of cooking. Come back after the break of day.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
既然我在值班，就不能进行个人的烹饪研究了。等休息的时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Just in time. I just have a moment to spare and I'd like to keep working on my study of the cuisine in the new continent. Would you get some ingredients for me?
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
正好。我刚好有点空，想继续研究新大陆的料理。你能帮我弄些食材吗？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What I need to day is the ^0000cdBun^000000. We have something similar in Lasagna, but the recipe is totally different.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我今天需要的是^0000cd馒头^000000。罗札纳有类似的东西，但配方完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What I need to day are the ^0000cdCat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food^000000. I am curious how the crews of Navi survived through such a long voyage.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我今天需要的是^0000cd猫干粮和玛朗多罐头^000000。我很好奇Navi的船员们是如何在漫长的航行中生存下来的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I need ^0000cdIce Cubes^000000 today. I have heard that the Ice Cubes from this one cave doesn't melt even in the middle of summer.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我今天需要^0000cd冰块^000000。我听说这个洞穴里的冰块即使在盛夏也不会融化。

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副厨师长]

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to know how it is made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd20 Buns^000000 would do.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我想知道它是怎么做的。请带一些给我。^0000cd20个馒头^000000就够了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to know how they are made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000 would do.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
我想知道它们是怎么做的。请带一些给我。^0000cd5个猫干粮和5个玛朗多罐头^000000就够了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If we had those, we could keep food fresh and drink cold Kahlugna Milk anytime. ^0000cd20 Ice Cubes^000000 would do, Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
如果有了它们，我们就能随时保持食物新鲜，并让卡鲁纳牛奶保持冰镇。^0000cd20个冰块^000000就够了，谢谢你。

scripts.text: What do you expect me to do without the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 没有食材，你指望我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Bring me {0} now!
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
现在就把{0}带给我！

scripts.text: Oh, you have brought them all! Let me cook them for you right away.
scripts.translation: 哦，你都带来了！让我马上为你烹饪。

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副厨师长]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The adventurer from the new continent. What brought you here? Do you need help?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
来自新大陆的冒险者。是什么把你带到这里的？需要帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说因为大雾，我们无法出发。我是来查看洞穴里那条龙的情况的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Are you going to do that yourself?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你要自己去吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很着急。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The fog is covering the sky. The ^0000cdpatrol^000000 hasn't returned yet, so it may take some time.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
大雾笼罩着天空。^0000cd巡逻队^000000还没有回来，可能需要一些时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please let me know where the dragon lives.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我龙住在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Come with me then. The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
那就跟我来吧。<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龙巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村庄外田野尽头的洞穴里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What are you doing here? Did you miss the ship?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你在这里做什么？是错过了船吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说因为大雾，我们无法出发。我是来查看洞穴里那条龙的情况的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The fog? Huh! The fog! When did this happen? And the patrol hasn't returned yet.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
大雾？哈！大雾！这是什么时候开始的？而且巡逻队还没有回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then the Dragon is...

[Vigilante]
The patrol who went to check it ^0000cdhasn't returned yet^000000. Something must have happened. You said you would go there to check the condition of the dragon, right? Come with me.Stone
scripts.translation:
[义警]
去查看情况的巡逻队^0000cd还没有回来^000000。一定发生了什么。你说你要去查看龙的情况，对吧？跟我来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where?

[Vigilante]
You know, the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. It is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village. You should go first. I'll follow you after making some preparations.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你知道的，<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龙巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。它在村庄外田野尽头的洞穴里。你应该先走，我做好准备后就跟上来。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave on the right side. Come with me then.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龙巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>在右边的洞穴里。那就跟我来吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I'll follow you. <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
我会跟着你的。<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龙巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村庄外田野尽头的洞穴里。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The wind is very uneasy today.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
今天的风很不平静。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I don't see it near here. We should go deeper!
scripts.translation:
[义警]
附近没看到。我们应该深入一点！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
......

[Machie]
I may have feigned death, but I am not a coward. It really was huge and frightening. Well, this is not important now. Just go to Tartufi. Tell him that I am sorry that I cannot make it today.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
我虽然装死，但绝不是胆小鬼。那家伙真的巨大又可怕。不过现在这不重要。去找塔尔图菲吧。告诉他我很抱歉，今天去不了了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Have you taken care of it already? You are fast. I am going to take a rest now. You may go now!
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
你已经处理好了吗？动作真快。我要休息一下了。你可以走了！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
The Basilisks are acting strange today.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
今天的蛇怪行为很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Argh...

[Vigilante]
Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? Oh, my...
scripts.translation:
[义警]
嘿！玛琪！醒醒！发生什么事了？天哪...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this!
scripts.translation:
[义警]
嘿！玛琪！醒醒！发生什么事了？你不是说要把你母亲从家乡接过来吗？你不能就这样死了！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this! Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你不是说要把你母亲从家乡接过来吗？你不能就这样死了！嘿，伙计！玛琪！别死在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
scripts.translation:
[义警]
嘿，伙计！玛琪！别死在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
don't kill a person with your words.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
别用言语杀人啊。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Machie?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
玛琪？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Phew... I tried so hard to fake death. Is it gone now?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
呼...我装死装得很辛苦。现在安全了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
The most ferocious, heinous and brutal basilisk. This thing was dangerous. It was the scariest basilisk that I had ever seen. I had sprained my ankle out of fear.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
那是最凶猛、最残忍、最野蛮的蛇怪。那家伙很危险。是我见过的最可怕的蛇怪。我吓得脚踝都扭伤了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
So you played dead? Good job. A vigilante should know how to save one's life. Good for you.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
所以你装死了？干得好。义警应该知道如何保命。做得不错。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is the situation that bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
情况有那么糟糕吗？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Who is this? A newbie?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
这是谁？新手吗？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Who is it? Someone from the new continent? A newbie to the Vigilante Corps?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
是谁？来自新大陆的人？义警部队的新手？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
No, the adventurer waiting for the sailing. I guess the ship is not setting off because of the fog. This guy came here to check things out.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
不，是那个等着坐船的冒险者。我想是因为雾太大，船没开。这家伙来这里查看情况。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I see. Tartufi is causing the trouble again. The basilisks are running wild today.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
看来塔尔图菲又惹麻烦了。今天那些蛇怪到处乱跑。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The good weather may have bothered them. Or they could have heard a tune of a flute or something.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
也许是天气太好让它们烦躁了。或者它们听到了笛声之类的。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
啊...请扶我一下。我走不太稳。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
亲爱的冒险者，我得带他去基地。你能独自去一趟吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
^0000cdTartufi^000000 is right upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is. He doesn't bite. You don't need to be scared.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
^0000cd塔尔图菲^000000就在楼上。去问问他怎么了。他不会咬人的，不用害怕。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll go there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You don't need to rush since the ship won't sail until Tartufi is at peace. Take your time. The ship cannot leave without you.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
不用着急，在塔尔图菲平静下来之前船是不会开的。慢慢来，没有你船是不会走的。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
It sounds very pressuring.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
听起来压力好大啊。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Is that so? I just wanted you to take your time. Well, get in there. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
是吗？我只是想让你别急。好了，进去吧。记住，塔尔图菲的平静就是海洋的平静。那意味着希望。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I am sorry to send you alone!
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
抱歉让你一个人去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, how can I find the dragon's nest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我怎么才能找到龙巢？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
It is hard to miss. You can tell that it is the dragon's nest when you see it. It is located in a high place and very flashy... Well, you can just tell.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
很好找的。看到就知道那是龙巢了。它在一个很高的地方，而且非常显眼...嗯，你一看就会知道的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我这就回来。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Yes! don't be scared!
scripts.translation:
[义警]
好的！别害怕！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I heard that ^0000cdan outsider had been messing with the basilisks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
我听说^0000cd有个外人在招惹那些蛇怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I may have caused it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想可能是我造成的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Really?
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What for? You don't get anything good from hunting down the basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
为什么？猎杀蛇怪对你没有任何好处。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Out of curiosity perhaps. I would poke at everything if I go to the new continent too. Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
也许是出于好奇吧。如果我去新大陆，也会到处乱碰的。啊...请扶我一下。我走不太稳。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone? ^0000cdTartufi^000000 is upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
亲爱的冒险者，我得带他去基地。你能独自去一趟吗？^0000cd塔尔图菲^000000在楼上。去问问他怎么了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I think the adventurer knows what the problem is already.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
我想，这位冒险者已经知道问题出在哪里了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
You don't have to say it like that.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
你不用说得那么直白。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Nothing like this would have happened if that guy just left the basilisks alone. Well, go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
要是那家伙当初没去招惹蛇怪，就不会发生这种事了。好了，去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope. Please ingratiate yourself with Tartufi.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
记住，塔尔图菲的安宁就是海洋的安宁，它意味着希望。请务必讨好塔尔图菲。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll make sure to resolve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我会一定解决这个问题的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You go ahead and see Tartufi. I'll take Machie with me after taking a rest. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你先去见塔尔图菲吧。我休息一会儿后就会带玛琪过去。记住，塔尔图菲的安宁就是海洋的安宁，它意味着希望。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Tartufi must have calmed down. Please go first. I'll go with Machie when he can walk a little. It is too heavy to carry him on my back.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
塔尔图菲应该已经冷静下来了。请你先走。等玛琪能走几步了，我再跟他过去。背着他太沉了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Can you stand up?
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你能站起来吗？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
No. I hope someone carries me on his back...
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
不能。我希望有人能背我...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You are saying that for me to hear. don't you even dream of it. I am tired tool.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
你这话是说给我听的吧？别做梦了。我累死了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Tut.
scripts.translation:
[玛琪]
啧。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. For what fame and riches am I doing here all alone...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
讨厌的苍蝇。讨厌的蚊子。真烦人。我孤身一人待在这里，图的是什么名声和财富...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔尔图菲？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你们够烦人的了。今天到底怎么回事？你们都是飞蛾扑火吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I'm not a basilisk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，我不是蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Who are you? Then again, I've never seen you before... Where's Magchi?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你是谁？不过，我好像没见过你...玛琪呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
玛琪在巡逻时受伤了，已经回去了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Oh no. What happened?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
哦不。发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A huge basilisk appeared and he was so startled that he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出现了一只巨大的蛇怪，他吓坏了，伤了腿。另一位义警带他走了，我相信他应该安全回去了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeah? Then I guess he's not dead. I was always curious about the rest of the story that Magchi used to tell me every day. Oh, do you that story too?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
是吗？那他应该没死。我一直很好奇玛琪每天讲给我的那个故事的后续。哦，你也知道那个故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
It's [I Witnessed a Murder on the Evening of Full Moon]. Tell me, if you know the story.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
故事叫《满月之夜的谋杀目击者》。如果你知道的话，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No clue. I've never heard of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全不知道。我从来没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Really? Then did Magchi make up that story? And are you going to take care of them?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
真的吗？那玛琪是在编故事吗？还有，你要去照顾它们吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
照顾什么？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi used to fight off the basilisks that came this way every day. Without Magchi, they're being troublesome today. So annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
玛琪以前每天都会赶走那些从这边来的蛇怪。没有玛琪，它们今天就很麻烦。真烦人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来你喷火是为了这个。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
因为这样能暂时把它们吓走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
港口因为那些烟雾被浓雾笼罩了。所以船无法起航，我来调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Set sail? Then are you an adventurer? I heard from Magchi that a new world has been discovered. An unknown land where no one has gone before. I wish I can go, too.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
起航？那你就是冒险者吗？我听玛琪说发现了一个新世界。那是无人踏足过的未知土地。我也想去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can go right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你现在就可以去。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No. My mom and dad left just recently. I must stay here and grow up a bit more. Sleep a lot and eat a lot. Once I become strong and tough, I'll go for a sightseeing.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
不行。我爸爸妈妈刚刚离开。我必须留在这里再长大一点。多睡点觉，多吃点东西。等我变得强壮结实了，再去观光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're this big and still call yourself a child?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你都这么大了，还自称孩子？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
don't call me a little child though. I'm only 457 years old. But then again, I'm a child compared to grandpa hiding somewhere over there.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
别叫我小孩子。我才457岁。不过和躲在那边某处的爷爷比起来，我还是个小孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Grandpa? Who?

[Tartufi]
He's ^0000cdImoogi^000000, somewhat of a basilisk chief. But I don't know. He's complaining about how if it weren't for ^0000cdmy mom and dad, he would've ascended to heaven already^000000. So he always has basilisks on loose to harass me.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
他是^0000cd伊莫吉^000000，算是蛇怪的首领。不过我也不太清楚。他总是在抱怨，要不是有^0000cd我爸妈^000000，他早就升天去了。所以他总是放蛇怪出来骚扰我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my.

[Tartufi]
Oh! There are basilisks coming this way again. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
哦！又有蛇怪朝这边来了。拜托，请处理掉它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Well, Magchi used to wield some type of long pole. Maybe that would do. ^0000cdAt least 20^000000 must be taken care of before they run away.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
嗯，玛琪以前用一种长杆武器。也许那会有用。在它们逃跑之前，至少要处理掉^0000cd20^000000只。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I picked up a few things so let me give them a try. Wait.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我捡了一些东西，让我试试。等等。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
They just never give up, do they? But you must try a little harder. They're nowhere near done because they know that you're weak. So you must show your strong side!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
它们就是不肯放弃，对吧？但你要更努力一点。它们还没完，因为它们知道你很弱。所以你必须展现出强大的一面！

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
They'll be quiet for a while if you show them that you're strong. So try a little harder. I'll help you.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
如果你向它们展示你的强大，它们就会安静一会儿。所以再努力一点吧。我会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Is he gone? I guess he is. That ought to keep them quiet for a while. Got me all worried at first because he said he was a rookie adventurer, but he should be able to pull off one doram's bit.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
他走了吗？我想是的。这样它们应该会安静一会儿。一开始我很担心，因为他说是个新手冒险者，但他应该能应付一只多兰的把戏。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone treats me like a new eggring, but I've also completed a formal training course!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都把我当成刚出生的蛋黄波利，但我可是完成过正规训练课程的！

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi tells me that It's a short, intensive program. But would that be enough? You went through a hell of a training while taking down those basilisks, so you're no longer a rookie.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
玛琪告诉我，那只是一个短期的强化课程。但那足够吗？你在击败那些蛇怪时经历了地狱般的训练，所以你不再是新手了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, yeah. Thanks.

[Tartufi]
By the time he's ready to run around again, Magchi will come. Thanks a lot. You said you're heading for an adventure in the new world? Tell me about the new world when you're in Lasagna time to time.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
等他准备好再次行动时，玛琪就会来。非常感谢。你说你要去新世界冒险？等你在罗札纳有空的时候，跟我讲讲新世界吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will. Farewell, then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会的。那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
It was short, but I really enjoyed your being here. Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
虽然时间很短，但我真的很高兴你能来。再见。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Zzz... zzz...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It must be somewhere near here that can communicate with Imoogi.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里附近一定有什么地方能与伊穆克沟通。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you?

[{0}]
A g-ghost?

[???]
How dare you treat me like a ghost! I have lived for ^0000cd2,500 years^000000!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你竟敢把我当成幽灵！我已经活了^0000cd2,500年^000000了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oww...that hurts. I'm sorry if I've offended you, but are you Imoogi, the chief of the Basilisk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哟...好痛。抱歉如果冒犯到你了，但你是蛇怪的首领伊穆克吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Your language is as vulgar as your appearance.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
你的言语和你的外表一样粗俗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what Tartufi said.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是塔尔图菲说的。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
He's young and foolish from lack of learning. I am Imook. I am called ^0000cdLord Imuk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
他年轻无知，缺乏学识。我是伊穆克。人们称我为^0000cd伊穆克大人^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lord Imuk... Did you say you lived for 2,500 years?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
伊穆克大人...你说你活了2,500年？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Yes. And I was supposed to ^0000cdbecome a dragon and ascend to heaven^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
是的。而且我本应^0000cd化身为龙并升天^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ascend? You mean going up to the heaven?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
升天？你是说升到天上吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
I can ^0000cdascend to heaven by training for 1,000 years and becoming a dragon^000000. But the ^0000cdmother and father of that young one^000000 snatched ^0000cdYeouiju^000000 twice in the past and ascended instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
我本可以^0000cd修炼一千年，化身为龙并升天^000000。但那个年轻人的^0000cd父母^000000过去曾两次抢夺^0000cd延久^000000，并代替我升天了。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
And now, that young one is hiding Yeouiju somewhere and seeking for a chance to ascend after 500 years. I will regain what's mine. My rights are justified.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
现在，那个年轻人把延久藏了起来，正伺机在500年后升天。我要夺回属于我的东西。我的权利是正当的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Seems like Yeouiju is a must-have in order to become a dragon. Is that why the basilisks are bothering Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来延久是化身为龙的必需品。这就是为什么蝾螈一直在骚扰塔尔图菲吗？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
The ^0000cdbasilisks are charged with the task of recovering Yeouiju^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
^0000cd蝾螈被赋予了夺回延久的任务^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, Tartufi breathes fire when he's attacked, and the smoke smothers the town. This keeps people from traveling freely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看，塔尔图菲被攻击时会喷火，烟雾会笼罩城镇。这让人们无法自由出行。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
I'm sorry to hear that. But that young one is at fault. Basilisks will continue with their task until the Yeouiju is recovered.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
听到这个我很遗憾。但错在那个年轻人。在夺回延久之前，蝾螈会继续执行任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm... I understand. So you have no intention of giving up until you get that Yeouiju. I'll ask Tartufi about Yeouiju.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我明白了。看来在你拿到延久之前是不会罢休的。我会去问问塔尔图菲关于延久的事。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Thanks. Now I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
谢谢。现在我要继续修炼了，不要打扰我，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Tell the young one about Yeouiju. I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
告诉那个年轻人关于延久的事。我要继续修炼了，不要打扰我，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. I miss mom and dad.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
讨厌的苍蝇。讨厌的蚊子。真烦人。我想爸爸妈妈了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔尔图菲？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? Tiger strike wasn't enough? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你们已经够烦人的了。今天怎么都这么不对劲？老虎扑击还不够吗？你们都是老虎蛾吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I'm not a basilisk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，我不是蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Who are you? Your clothes are weird and you look weird. Where did Magchi go?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你是谁？你的衣服很奇怪，样子也很奇怪。马吉去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back. And I'm from the new world.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
马吉在巡逻时受伤回去了。我来自新世界。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I see. You're from the new world. But what about Magchi?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
原来如此。你来自新世界。但是马吉呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Basilisks went on a rampage and he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
蝾螈发狂了，他伤了腿。另一位义警带走了他，我相信他安全返回了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeah? Then That's a relief. But I don't know what's gotten into these creatures. They were quiet just until now.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
是吗？那就好。但我不知道这些生物怎么了。直到刚才它们都很安静。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was after the basilisks just before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我刚才一直在追那些蝾螈。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
What? You went after the basilisks? You?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
什么？你去追蝾螈了？你？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh... yes. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...是的。对不起。我不是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No, no. I'm not saying what you did was wrong. But can you tell me more about that?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
不，不。我不是说你做错了什么。但你能多告诉我一些关于那件事的情况吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was asked to find some basils. I heard that I can find them from the basilisks, so I came all the way here to catch them. I guess that must've excited them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受命去寻找一些罗勒。听说可以从蝾螈身上找到，所以我一路来到这里捕捉它们。我想那一定让它们很兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I see. Then are you strong? You said you caught some basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
我明白了。那你很强吗？你说你捕捉了一些蝾螈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess you can say that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我想你可以这么说...

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi just drove off the basilisks that came this way every day. That was enough, but without Magchi, they are bothering me again. So annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
马奇只是赶走了每天朝这边来的蝾螈。那样就足够了，但没有马奇，它们又来找我的麻烦了。真烦人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来你喷火是为了这个。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
因为这样能暂时把它们吓走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
港口因为那些烟雾被浓雾笼罩了。所以船无法起航，我来调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Set sail? Ah, right. You said you were from the new world. Then can I ask for a favor? Please tell their ^0000cdchief^000000 to keep them quiet.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
扬帆起航？啊，对。你说你是来自新世界的。那么我能请你帮个忙吗？请告诉他们的^0000cd首领^000000让它们安静点。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
His name is Imoogi. I don't know where he lives, but there's something ^0000cdup there that can communicate with Imoogi^000000. Basilisks go there every morning and hear something...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
他的名字叫伊穆克。我不知道他住在哪里，但那里有^0000cd某种能与伊穆克沟通的东西^000000。蝾螈每天早上都会去那里听一些东西...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Sorry about the basilisks. I'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。抱歉关于蝾螈的事。我会处理好的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Okay. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
好的。回头见。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Did you get to talk with Imoogi? What did he say? Not yet? Hurry up. The basilisks are so annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你和伊穆克谈过了吗？他说了什么？还没吗？快点。蝾螈太烦人了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You here. So how did it go?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你来了。那么情况如何？

scripts.text: [You tell Tartufi about the story of Lord Imuk and Yeouiju.]
scripts.translation: [你向塔尔图菲讲述了伊穆克大人与如意珠的故事。]

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeouiju? What's that?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
如意珠？那是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not exactly sure, but It's a must-have to become a dragon and ascend to the heaven.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不太确定，但它是变成龙并升天所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Whatever it is, I'll look for it. It should take some time to look for it here somewhere. But in the meanwhile, can you take care of them?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
不管它是什么，我会去找的。在这里找它可能需要一些时间。但在此期间，你能照顾一下它们吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will. How long would it take?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会的。需要多久？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I don't know. Perhaps 200 years or so?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
我不知道。也许200年左右？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Think about it. It takes about that much time to search through everything here. On top of that, I don't even know what Yeouiju is.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
想想看。在这里搜索所有东西大约需要那么长时间。而且，我甚至不知道如意珠是什么。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Anyway, I'll look for it, so you take care of them. Just today. Tomorrow, perhaps Magchi will come and get rid of them. But today, you do it. I heard It's because of you.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
总之，我会去找它的，所以你去照顾它们。就今天。明天，也许马奇会来把它们赶走。但今天，由你来。我听说这是因为你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。如果你碰巧找到了如意珠，请告诉伊穆克大人。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I'll think about it. I don't even know what that is. I can't promise you without knowing what it is.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
我会考虑的。我甚至不知道那是什么。在不知道它是什么的情况下，我无法向你保证。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess you're right. I can't wait forever so I should get rid of those basilisks. How many should I take care of?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说得对。我不能永远等下去，所以我应该解决那些蛇怪。我需要处理多少只？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Get rid of ^0000cd20 or so^000000 and they won't come near from fear.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
解决掉^0000cd20只左右^000000，它们就会因为恐惧而不敢靠近了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。如果你碰巧找到了如意珠，请告诉伊穆克大人。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No, not yet. They keep coming. I said not yet.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
不，还没完。它们还在不断出现。我说了还没完。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Did you forget? You must get rid of at least 20 basilisks before they get quiet.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
你忘了吗？在它们安静下来之前，你必须至少解决掉20只蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whew. All taken care of.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼。都处理好了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Good job. That should keep them quiet now. I'm going to look through my treasure but I need to sleep first. I'm sleepy cuz I've been up for so long today.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
干得好。现在它们应该安静了。我要去翻找我的宝物，但我得先睡一觉。因为我今天醒得太久，很困。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'm sure Lord Imuk will wait as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我相信伊穆克大人也会等待的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Fine. You're boarding on a ship, right? I hope you get to your destination safely.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
好的。你正要上船，对吧？祝你平安抵达目的地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks. I think I can sail off in a nice weather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢。我想天气不错，可以出发了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No prob. Farewell, then.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
不客气。那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I heard you're boarding on a ship. Shouldn't you hurry?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
听说你要上船。你不该快点吗？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Zzz... zzz...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔图菲]
呼...呼...

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Only the vigilantes can eat here.
scripts.translation:
义警厨师
只有义警才能在这里用餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello.

[Chief Peperoncino]
You're from our adventurers' club {0} Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
你是来自我们冒险者俱乐部{0}的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
You're from the new world? What does a person from the new world want with me?
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
你是来自新世界的？一个来自新世界的人找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You remember me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你记得我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I remember everyone that I've crossed paths with.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
我记得每一个与我擦肩而过的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Besides seeking for new adventures, listening to other people's stories is an adventurer's duty. From what I gather, you've been in Lasagna longer than most people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
除了寻找新的冒险，倾听他人的故事也是冒险者的职责。据我了解，你在罗札纳待的时间比大多数人都长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone recommended that I should ask you for stories on Lasagna and Farfalle Vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都建议我来向你打听关于罗札纳和法尔法雷义警的故事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Listening to other people's adventure stories is one of the virtues of an adventurer. If you can listen carefully and learn something from other people, they'll be valuable lessons on life.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
倾听他人的冒险故事是冒险者的美德之一。如果你能仔细聆听，并从他人身上学到东西，那将是宝贵的人生经验。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
So what are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
那么，你对什么感到好奇呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm curious about your story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很好奇你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
My story... Why are you curious? But since you asked, I'll tell you. I was born outside of Lasagna called ^0000cdFusilli^000000. Back then, you mention the name Peperoncino and everyone in Fusilli knew.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
我的故事... 你为什么好奇？不过既然你问了，我就告诉你。我出生在罗札纳之外的^0000cd富西利^000000。那时候，只要提到佩佩龙奇诺这个名字，富西利的人都知道。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Sir, That's not what you said the last time we talked over a drink. You said you left because you hated being looked down upon due to poverty.
scripts.translation:
[义警]
先生，这和你上次喝酒时说的不一样。你当时说，你离开是因为讨厌因为贫穷而被看不起。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
What are you talking about? You must've been very drunk that day. What more can an adventurer ask for when you get to experience so many things in a vast ocean?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
你在说什么？那天你肯定喝醉了。在广阔的大海上体验了这么多事情，一个冒险者还能要求什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
But unfortunately, ^0000cdI became unable to be on a ship^000000. I can't tell you why. It's classified information.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
但不幸的是，^0000cd我变得无法上船了^000000。我不能告诉你原因。这是机密信息。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Seasickness.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
晕船。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Then I saw the unlimited potential of fishing industry, or anchovy manufacturing to be more exact. So I jumped into the ^0000cdanchovy manufacturing business^000000. And I met Gamberry around that time.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
然后我看到了渔业无限的潜力，或者更确切地说是鳀鱼制造业。于是我投身于^0000cd鳀鱼制造业^000000。就在那时，我遇到了甘贝利。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
^0000cdGamberry was a hoodlum who reminded me of a ruffian^000000. He soon was moved by my words and joined me in the business.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
^0000cd甘贝利是个让我想起恶棍的混混^000000。他很快被我的话打动，加入了我的事业。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
I heard you guys fought.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
我听说你们打过架。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Of course there were small disputes, but Gamberry was moved by my leadership and became influenced. After we gained enough experience and know-hows from anchovy manufacturing, we decided to draw a bigger picture.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
当然有一些小争执，但甘贝利被我的领导力所打动，并受到了影响。在我们从鳀鱼制造业中积累了足够的经验和知识后，我们决定画一个更大的蓝图。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
It was ^0000cdselling specialty products^000000. Gamberry's friend ^0000cdThomas^000000 joined the venture and we decided to start the business in Lasagna. But the problem was ^0000cdlousy dorams^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
那就是^0000cd销售特色产品^000000。甘贝利的朋友^0000cd托马斯^000000加入了这项事业，我们决定在罗札纳开始生意。但问题是^0000cd糟糕的多兰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
They would pick on every single thing so I decided to catch them and make them work.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
他们对每件事都挑三拣四，所以我决定抓住他们，让他们工作。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
That story doesn't add up.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
这个故事对不上。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
At any rate, Captain Gamberry is a good man. He was influenced by me since his ragtag days and now he's become a doram.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
无论如何，甘贝利船长是个好人。他从我落魄的时候就受到了我的影响，现在他成了一个多兰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How was Lasagna in the past?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
过去的罗札纳是什么样的？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Lasagna was just awful when I first came here. You breathe and someone picks a fight. You walk and fights break out. Captain Gamberry went around putting the brakes on those crowds, but my first impression of him was no different from them.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
我刚来罗札纳时，这里简直糟透了。你呼吸一下，就有人找茬。你走一步，就爆发打架。甘贝利船长四处奔走，试图阻止那些人群，但我对他的第一印象和他们没什么不同。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
If violence subdues violence, then what will subdue that violence? Anyway, Lasagna was like a rotten trash can. In comparison, Fusilli is a town with totally innocent people!
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
如果暴力能压制暴力，那么什么能压制那种暴力呢？总之，罗札纳就像一个腐朽的垃圾桶。相比之下，富西利是一个完全由无辜的人组成的城镇！

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
I ask the newcomers about Fusilli and none of them knows. It must be in the backwoods or something.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
我问过新来的人关于富西利的事，他们都不知道。那地方肯定是在什么偏僻的荒野里吧。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Anyhow, the biggest obstacle when we started the business was Lasagna's lousy dorams. They pounced on me for a fight. Is everyone who live by sea so belligerent like that?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
总之，我们刚开始做生意时，最大的障碍就是罗札纳那些糟糕的多兰。他们总是扑上来找架打。难道所有靠海为生的人都这么好斗吗？

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
No, don't insult them. It's this place That's unusual.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
不，别侮辱他们。是这个地方才不正常。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
At first, I tried to persuade those lousy dorams through conversation. I tried to be a gentleman but they wouldn't listen. That's when Gamberry took the matters into his own hands.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
起初，我试着通过对话来说服那些糟糕的多兰。我试图表现得像个绅士，但他们根本不听。就在那时，甘贝利亲自出手了。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
didn't I tell you just before? He took care of it completely. I gathered those lousy dorams and spoke to them. They were so touched by my speech that they volunteered to join the vigilance corps.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
我不是刚跟你说过吗？他彻底解决了这件事。我把那些糟糕的多兰召集起来跟他们谈话。他们被我的演讲深深打动了，主动申请加入义警队。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Hmph! Anyway, with the efforts of vigilance corps and merchants, Lasagna was reborn to its current state.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
哼！总之，在义警队和商人的共同努力下，罗札纳才重生为现在的样子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How are the vigilance corps and merchants?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
义警队和商人现在怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
The ^0000cdvigilance corps and merchants^000000 are... um... Among several organizations that run Lasagna, you can say that the two created today's Lasagna. And Gamberry, Thomas, and I were at the heart of it.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
^0000cd义警队和商人^000000嘛... 嗯... 在管理罗札纳的几个组织中，可以说正是这两者造就了今天的罗札纳。而甘贝利、托马斯和我，则是其中的核心。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
When we jumped into the specialty product business, many dorams who were moved by us wanted to help.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
当我们投身于特产生意时，许多被我们感动的多兰都想要帮忙。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
See what I mean? Different version from the last.
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
你懂我的意思吗？这和刚才说的版本不一样啊。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
We gathered those lousy dorams and sent them to the vigilance corps and merchants. Lasagna's ^0000cdmaintenance of order was handled by the vigilantes^000000, and ^0000cdeverything related to the products was handled by the merchants^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
我们召集了那些糟糕的多兰，把他们分派到义警队和商人那里。罗札纳的^0000cd秩序维护由义警负责^000000，而^0000cd与产品相关的一切事务则由商人负责^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
To expand our flourishing business, we ^0000cdbegan sea trade^000000. But during this time, ^0000cdThomas's ship Butterfly went missing in a typhoon^000000.
