scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
为了扩大我们蓬勃发展的生意，我们^0000cd开始了海上贸易^000000。但在此期间，^0000cd托马斯的船“蝴蝶号”在台风中失踪了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
I ^0000cdpersistently persuaded the captain and crewmen of Con-Chliina to find Butterfly^000000. My efforts finally paid off and we found them on a ^0000cdremote island in the new world^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
我^0000cd坚持不懈地劝说“康克里纳号”的船长和船员去寻找“蝴蝶号”^000000。我的努力终于有了回报，我们在^0000cd新世界的偏僻岛上^000000找到了他们。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Well, that was Stello of Con-Chliina...
scripts.translation:
义警 厨师
嗯，那是“康克里纳号”的斯特洛...

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Anything else you're curious about?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龙奇诺]
你还有什么好奇的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That was... what an amazing adventure. Thank you for sharing your story. I can clearly see where your dignified manner comes from.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那真是... 一段惊人的冒险。谢谢你分享你的故事。我现在能明白你为何如此庄重了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你的时间。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
希望有一天能听到你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation:
[首领 佩佩龙奇诺]
希望有一天能听到你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Who's is it? Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
是谁？谁在那儿？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wow, you have an amazing sensing ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，你的感知能力真强。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you live alone for a long time, you get sensitive to the slightest noise. So what brings you here? I'm out of kaluna milk right now. Do you want to order something else?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
一个人住久了，对细微的声响都会变得敏感。
所以，是什么风把你吹来了？
我现在正好没有卡鲁纳牛奶了。
你想点别的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's something I wanted to ask you. Do you remember anything about Captain Gamberry and Chief Peperoncino?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实我有件事想问你。
你还记得船长甘贝里和首领佩佩龙奇诺吗？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, those eggring boys. Speaking of which, I haven't seen them much lately. Did they give up and leave Lasagna?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，是那群蛋黄波利小子。
说起来，我最近都没怎么见到他们。
他们是放弃这里，离开罗札纳了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they're both well and still in Lasagna. I'm here because there is something I wanted to know about Captain Gamberry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他们都很好，还留在罗札纳。
我来这里是因为我想知道一些关于船长甘贝里的事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Captain? Captain who? Gamberry? That eggring boy? Oh, you're right. He did become a captain. I remember when he showed up in my pub with Pepe.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
船长？哪个船长？甘贝里？
那个蛋黄波利小子？
啊，你说得对。他确实成了船长。
我记得他带着佩佩来到我酒馆的时候。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pepe?

[Grandma]
^0000cdPepe. Peperoncino. Gamberry is Berry, and Tomei Thomas is Toto^000000. I guess young people don't know. Anyway, they were like wild basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
^0000cd佩佩。佩佩龙奇诺。甘贝里是贝瑞，托梅·托马斯是托托^000000。
我想现在的年轻人都不知道了。
反正，他们当时就像一群野生的巴希利斯克。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Are the basilisks still in the cave? When we were young, we didn't even go near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那些巴希利斯克还在洞穴里吗？
我们年轻的时候，连洞穴附近都不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what happened then? They showed up at the pub and what did they do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那后来发生了什么？
他们来到酒馆后做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, right. Pepe looked like a homeless and ordered kaluna milk. That's when Berry picked a fight, saying that only the kids have it shaken.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，对了。佩佩当时看起来像个流浪汉，点了卡鲁纳牛奶。
就是那时候，贝瑞挑起了事端，说只有小孩子才喝加奶的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
So they ^0000cdfought^000000. My ^0000cdstore was destroyed^000000. So I made a ^0000cdclaim for damages^000000 for broken furniture and profit loss until the pub was back in business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
于是他们^0000cd打了起来^000000。
我的^0000cd店被砸了^000000。
所以我提交了^0000cd损害赔偿申请^000000，包括家具损坏和酒馆停业期间的利润损失。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You mentioned Pepe. Seemed like he was poor there as well. He came to Lasagna after hearing from somewhere that he can make a lot of money on anchovy fishing boat, but quit because of seasickness.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你提到了佩佩。看来他那时候也很穷。
他听说在鳀鱼船上能赚大钱，就来到了罗札纳，但因为晕船而辞职了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
After that, he couldn't get on a boat ever again. Haha. He became indebted because of the ^0000cdpenalty for breach of contract^000000 and couldn't leave. So he ended up in the anchovy workshop where he removes anchovy head and guts...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
从那以后，他就再也上不了船了。哈哈。
他因为^0000cd违约罚金^000000而负债累累，无法离开。
最后他只好在鳀鱼工坊工作，负责去头去内脏...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Anyway, he had a huge debt from the boat and pub. The two mulled over what to do and ended up at the ^0000cdanchovy workshop^000000. Few years later, ^0000cdGamberry became the workshop manager^000000. The job was perfect for him.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
总之，他欠了船费和酒馆的债。
两人商量后，最终去了^0000cd鳀鱼工坊^000000。
几年后，^0000cd甘贝里成了工坊管理员^000000。
这份工作非常适合他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How was Lasagna in the old days?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
以前的罗札纳是什么样的？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
don't even mention it. It was a mess. The roads were awful. People were awful. there's a reason why the past is called the dark ages.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
别提了。那时候简直是一团糟。
路很烂，人也很烂。
过去被称为“黑暗时代”是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Have you ever stepped on fish guts on a road? That's how Lasagna was back then.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你曾在路上踩过鱼内脏吗？
以前的罗札纳就是那样的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Then one day, two roughnecks came up with the merchants and vigilance corps and started beating up Lasagna kids.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
然后有一天，两个粗汉带着商人和治安队，开始殴打罗札纳的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I guess sticks do make dorams. The two sent those hoodlums to the merchants and vigilance corps. Mm... I remember those boys. Their beards were cut and tails were tattered.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
看来棍棒确实能造就多兰。
那两人把那些流氓交给了商人和治安队。
嗯...我记得那两个男孩。他们的胡子被剃了，尾巴也被剪秃了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Those doram mouse-looking ones all left Lasagna and only the ones who wanted to live a decent life stayed. They're the ones who made current Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那些看起来像多兰老鼠的家伙都离开了罗札纳，只有想好好生活的人留了下来。
是他们造就了现在的罗札纳。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
But who are you? Did you come to order kaluna milk? Stirred or shaken? Where did all my workers go?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
不过你是谁？你是来点卡鲁纳牛奶的吗？搅拌还是摇匀？我的工人们都去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll get going now...

[Grandma]
With no customers, my pub will soon be out of business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
没有顾客的话，我的酒馆很快就要倒闭了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
If you're not going to order anything, get the heck out!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
如果你不打算点单，就给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Zzz...zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
呼...呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It looks huge and heavy. Go and get rid of some.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
它看起来又大又重。去处理掉一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you wish to speak to me, then you'd better go and get some more experience.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
如果你想和我对话，最好先去多积攒一些经验值。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A glass of kaluna milk please.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请给我一杯卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: Stirred.
scripts.translation: 搅拌

scripts.text: Shaken.
scripts.translation: 摇匀

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you want to drink kaluna milk, then go see the guy next door. But you'd better hurry. Stirred or shaken, that won't matter pretty soon.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
如果你想喝卡鲁纳牛奶，就去隔壁找那个家伙。不过你最好快点。不管是搅拌还是摇匀，很快就没区别了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You know what the main ingredients of kaluna milk are? They're ^0000cdkaluna^000000, the essence made from fermenting a special shellfish called ^0000cdkalunyak^000000, and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你知道卡鲁纳牛奶的主要原料是什么吗？是^0000cd卡鲁纳^000000，一种由名为^0000cd卡鲁尼亚克^000000的特殊贝壳魔灵发酵制成的精华，以及新鲜牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Mix that in moderate temperate and garnish with a gooseberry. And then you get the kaluna milk that everyone loves.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
将它们以适中的温度混合，再点缀一颗鹅莓。这样就能做出大家都爱的卡鲁纳牛奶了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
But we're almost finished with the kaluna in store and the person who supplies us hasn't been here for days. Even the ones we had in stockpile are nearly gone.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
但我们库存的卡鲁纳快用完了，供应商好几天没来过了。就连储备的那些也快见底了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Without kaluna, there's no kaluna milk. You get what that means?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
没有卡鲁纳，就没有卡鲁纳牛奶。你明白这意味着什么吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这意味着什么？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It means customers who came for kaluna milk would have made their trip in vain.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
这意味着那些为了喝卡鲁纳牛奶而来的人，将白跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Angry people who didn't get to drink kaluna milk will soon cause a ^0000cdriot^000000, and soon it will spread over the entire Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
喝不到卡鲁纳牛奶的愤怒人群很快就会引发^0000cd暴动^000000，而且很快会蔓延到整个罗札纳。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then Lasagna will return to its former state of filth and danger. I can't let that happen. We're finally living like decent human beings but to go back to that dark age...
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
那样罗札纳就会回到过去肮脏和危险的状态。我不能让这种事发生。我们终于能像正常人一样生活了，却又要回到那个黑暗时代...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sure that won't happen just over a glass of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我相信不会仅仅因为一杯卡鲁纳牛奶就发生那种事。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You don't understand what kaluna milk means for people of Lasagna. It's not merely a drink that relaxes the body for these people.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你不懂卡鲁纳牛奶对罗札纳人意味着什么。对他们来说，这不仅仅是一杯能放松身体的饮品。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Kaluna milk also symbolizes ^0000cdfaith and friendship, as well as festival^000000. I can't discuss the details here, but if you're curious, go see the bookkeeper of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
卡鲁纳牛奶还象征着^0000cd信任、友谊以及节日^000000。这里不方便细说，如果你好奇，可以去问问康-奇利纳的记账员。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's a recording maniac who loves to record everything.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
他是个记录狂人，喜欢把一切都记录下来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not exactly sure, but I can tell It's really important for people here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不太确定，但我能感觉到这对这里的人来说非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right. That's what I'm talking about. You always start or finish the day with kaluna milk. But that kaluna is nearly all gone!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
没错，我就是这个意思。人们总是以卡鲁纳牛奶开始或结束一天。但现在卡鲁纳几乎都喝光了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you send someone over and find out what happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么不派个人去调查一下发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I'm not dumb you know. But there's no one to send! Look, everyone is busy.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
我又不是傻子。但是没人可派啊！你看，大家都忙得很。

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮你。

scripts.text: Oh no. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Yeah, I'm busy so you should get going. If you wish to drink kaluna milk, try the next door.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
是啊，我很忙，所以你也该走了。如果你想喝卡鲁纳牛奶，试试隔壁吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What? What did you just say? If I heard you correctly, you said you'd help me.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
什么？你刚才说什么？如果我没听错的话，你说你会帮我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You heard me right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没听错。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Dear lord, thank you. So this is how you repay me for all the nice deeds I've done.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
天哪，谢谢你。原来这就是你报答我所有善举的方式吗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who said I'll help you, but how come the lord gets the appreciation?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我说要帮你的，怎么感谢的是主啊？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Oh, not at all. I'm grateful to you, too. Anyways, if you go to the ^0000cdfishing hole near the south bridge^000000, you'll meet ^0000cdLegalas^000000 who is standing on crutches. He's the one who supplies us with kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
哦，不不不。我也很感激你。总之，如果你去^0000cd南桥附近的渔场^000000，会遇到拄着拐杖的^0000cd莱加拉斯^000000。他就是给我们供应卡鲁纳的人。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Most people in Lasagna work for the vigilante corps or merchants, so the town is always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
罗札纳的大多数人都为义警部队或商人工作，所以镇上总是人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So we hire outsiders who want a job as a special treatment policy, and Legalas is in charge of fermenting kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
所以我们作为特殊政策雇佣想工作的外地人，莱加拉斯负责发酵卡鲁纳。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's quite skilled at catching, cleaning, and fermenting kalunyak that Lasagna's kaluna milk is regarded as the best around here. Ah, this is not the important part.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
他在捕捉、清洗和发酵卡鲁纳克方面非常熟练，罗札纳的卡鲁纳牛奶被认为是这一带最好的。啊，这不是重点。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Go find Legalas and find out what's going on. And tell him to make delivery as soon as possible. At the rate we're going, we'll be out of stock after today.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
去找莱加拉斯，弄清楚发生了什么。并告诉他尽快送货。照这个速度，今天之后我们就断货了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, I'll go and find out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Didn't you say you were going to find out why Legalas was not able to make the delivery?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你刚才不是说要去看看莱加拉斯为什么没能送货吗？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I beg you. I'm really worried. Can't even sleep these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
拜托了。我真的非常担心，这几天都睡不着觉。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, what did Legalas say? Did he say he can deliver kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
冒险者，莱加拉斯怎么说？他有没有说能送来卡鲁纳？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Fortunately, he said he's close to meeting the delivery quota.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。幸运的是，他说他快要达到送货配额了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What a relief! But did tell you about what caused him the delay?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
真是松了一口气！不过，他有没有告诉你是什么导致了延误？

scripts.text: [You tell Kalu about the story of Daldal and Gopara.]
scripts.translation: [你向卡卢讲述了达尔达尔与戈帕拉的故事。]

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So what you're telling is that I should keep the two far away from the workshop while Legalas is working.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
所以你的意思是，在莱加拉斯工作的时候，我要把这两个家伙远远地赶出工坊。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I think That's something I can take care of. As a matter of fact, I have a ^0000cdlunchbox delivery to make inside the cave^000000. Every day, that is.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
我觉得这事我可以搞定。事实上，我每天都要往洞穴里送一次^0000cd午餐盒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Looks like the two can be sent to the delivery team while Legalas is working. For wage, a meal per day would do.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
看来可以让这两个家伙加入送货队，在莱加拉斯工作时替我跑腿。作为报酬，每天管一顿饭就行。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Cave? That's nice. I've always wanted to go there myself.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
洞穴？听起来不错。我一直都想去那里看看。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Whatever it is, I'm happy that I get to eat yummy food.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不管是什么，只要能有好吃的美食，我就开心。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Okay, then Let's get started right away! Take this lunchbox to the ^0000cdvigilante inside the cave. His name is Panna.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
好，那就马上开始！把这个午餐盒送到洞穴里的^0000cd义警^000000那里。他叫潘娜。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们走。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Get up.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
快起来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?

[Gopara]
We're a team.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们是一个团队。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
A team must move as one.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
团队必须行动一致。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since when was I part of the team? All right, fine... Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什么时候成团队的一员了？好吧，算了...走吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
只要把这个大午餐盒送到正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜那里就行了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I said I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我说我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job. While the three of you went to the cave, Legalas visited with kaluna. If we can keep this up every day, delivery will be no problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
干得好。你们三人去洞穴的时候，莱加拉斯带着卡卢纳来了。如果我们每天都能保持这样，送货就完全没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Adventurer, I'm counting on you tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
冒险者，明天也拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
If time permits, I'll be out early and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
如果时间允许的话，我会早点出门等着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?

[Gopara]
What were we called before?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们之前叫什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
One!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
一！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Team!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
队！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
One team. If I don't show up, they'll probably harass Legalas again. Fine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一队。如果我不出现，他们大概又会去纠缠莱加拉斯了。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Okay, give me food now.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
好了，现在给我食物。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm fine. Had too much kalunyak that I'm still digesting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我没事。吃了太多卡卢尼亚克，现在还在消化。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You should take this. Nice work.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你应该收下这个。干得好。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job today as well. Two of you, get some food. Adventurer, that this. I'm counting on you tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
今天也干得好。你们两个，吃点东西吧。冒险者，拿着这个。明天也拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
只要把这个大午餐盒送到正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜那里就行了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, you're here already? It's not the time for lunchbox delivery yet.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
冒险者，你来得这么早？现在还不是送午餐盒的时间。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. Timing is off.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没错。时间不对。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Timing is off!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
时间不对！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Come back after the daybreak.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
请在天亮后再来。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right on time. Two people are here already and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
准时。已经有两个人在这里等着了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yes, we've been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是的，我们一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Waited for a long time. Almost died waiting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
等了好久。都快等死了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then I ask that you ^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000 for today as well. Hurry up on your way there, but take your time on your way back.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
那么，今天也请你们^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000。去的时候快一点，回来的时候慢慢走。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们走。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Let's get going!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Stop eating! Stop! Shame on you!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
别吃了！停下！真丢人！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Enough already! You guys are getting worse and worse every day! don't you guys think this is too much? Have you no conscience?!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
够了！你们一天比一天过分！难道不觉得这样太过分了吗？你们没有良心吗？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Conscience? Mm... Sorry, but I don't know because I have no clue where my conscience is.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
良心？嗯...抱歉，我不知道，因为我根本不知道我的良心在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Probably in the chest, right? But what am I supposed to do with it?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
大概是在胸口吧？但我该怎么用它呢？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
The minute I catch kalunyak, you two devour it! You even ate the ones I had cleaned!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我每次抓到卡鲁尼亚克，你们俩就把它吃光！连我清理好的都吃了！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
didn't I tell you several times that those must be fermented and delivered? And the deadline has already passed!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我不是告诉过你们好几次吗？那些必须发酵后送去！而且截止日期已经过了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Really? I didn't know.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
真的吗？我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I did. But I couldn't help it.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我知道。但我忍不住。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh, are you Legalas who supplies kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你是供应卡鲁纳的莱加拉斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Now look! Someone is here because I couldn't make the delivery! I'm ruined now! I'll starve to death!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
你看！因为没完成送货，有人来了！我完蛋了！我要饿死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. The situation is bad but no need to be so pessimistic. Why is everyone here so extreme?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。情况虽然糟糕，但不必这么悲观。为什么这里的人都这么极端？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I don't know what you mean. Please explain.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我不明白你的意思。请解释一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kalu from the adventurers' club wants to know why the delivery is being late. He has enough to sell for today, so everything will be fine as long as you can deliver by today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冒险者俱乐部的卡卢想知道为什么送货晚了。他今天的货已经卖完了，所以只要今天能送到就没事。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Ha! Huh! Ha! I wish I can do that. But those two pigs are devouring the kalunyaks! At first, they ate one or two, but now they're at it the minute I catch one. I don't have the opportunity to clean and ferment it!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
哈！哼！哈！我真希望能那样。但那两头猪把卡鲁尼亚克都吃光了！起初，他们吃一两个，但现在我一抓到就吃。我没有机会清理和发酵！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
If you want kaluna, then do something about ^0000cdthose two over there^000000! I'm about to go crazy because not only do they leech onto me, now they're ruining my work. Perhaps It's better that I go back to the battlefield!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
如果你想要卡鲁纳，就去处理^0000cd那边那两个人^000000！我快疯了，因为他们不仅白吃白喝，还毁了我的工作。也许我最好回战场去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please calm down. I'll talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请冷静。我会跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
They won't listen no matter what. Look at those bellies. They're from eating so much kalunyak and kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
不管说什么他们都不听。看看他们的肚子。那是吃了太多卡鲁尼亚克和卡鲁纳的结果。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Who knows where the pigs suddenly disappeared to, but I hope they're not back anytime soon. I'm on a roll here! A little more, just a little more...!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
谁知道那些猪突然跑哪去了，但我希望它们别这么快就回来。我现在的状态正佳！再努力一点，就快完成了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Legalas, I tried everything to make them work, but they have neither the skills nor will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莱加拉斯，我试遍了所有办法想让他们干活，但他们既没技术也没意愿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But they promised that they won't eat kalunyak, so you won't have any problem with the delivery anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过他们保证不再吃卡鲁尼亚克了，所以你的送货问题应该不会再出现了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You seem to have some grudge against us. I'm going to tell Legalas everything as soon as he gets here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你好像对我们很有意见。等莱加拉斯来了，我会把一切都告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What did we do wrong anyway?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们到底做错了什么？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I was wondering why you suddenly took these two out. So That's what happened. It must've been difficult, taking them around with you.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我正纳闷你为什么要突然带这两个人出来。原来是这样。带着他们到处跑一定很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks to your sacrifice, I was able to make most of the ^0000cdkaluna^000000 I needed to deliver. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
多亏了你的牺牲，我才能做出大部分需要交付的^0000cd卡鲁纳^000000。非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You guys are openly being mean to us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你们明明就是在故意刁难我们。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalunyak is definitely the best.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
卡鲁尼亚克绝对是最好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Doh! That pig is eating kalunyak again!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
天哪！那头猪又在吃卡鲁尼亚克了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I was hungry. I can't eat anchovies anymore. I can only eat kalunyak now.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我饿了。我再也吃不下凤尾鱼了，现在只能吃卡鲁尼亚克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I have no work so I'll eat again.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我没事做，那就再吃点吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. I haven't met my delivery quota yet, but those two are eating all my kalunyaks! What you see is all I got for today and at this rate, I won't be able to fulfill the order.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
冒险者，我有件事想拜托你。我还没完成今天的送货配额，但那两个人把我的卡鲁尼亚克都吃光了！这就是我今天剩下的全部了，照这个速度下去，我没法完成订单。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please take them with you again, even for a short while!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
求你了，哪怕只是一小会儿，也请把他们带走吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to deliver some message to Kalu anyway, so I'll take the two with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
反正我也得给卡卢送个消息，我就带他们一起去吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please, I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
拜托了，求求你了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, how about we go to the ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我们要不去^0000cdPub-Oven^000000？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Fine. Anywhere as long as It's not boring.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
行吧。只要不无聊，去哪都行。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Does it have plenty of yummy food? If yes, I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
那里有很多好吃的吗？有的话我就去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's go then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks for keeping these pigs. Thanks to you, my job got easier!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
谢谢你们照顾这些猪。多亏了你们，我的工作轻松多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我有件事想告诉你们。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我现在有点腻了。但也没别的可吃的了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们什么时候是“想吃”才吃的？明明是因为“有”才吃的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys?

[Daldal]
What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
怎么了？你带了吃的来吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Are you going to play with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你要跟我们玩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说，你们把莱加拉斯清理的卡鲁尼亚克全吃光了。现在，用那些卡鲁尼亚克做的卡鲁纳快用完了。请你们稍微克制一下好吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Why should we?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
为什么要克制？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因为没有卡鲁尼亚克就做不出卡鲁纳奶。有个本该从莱加拉斯那里拿到卡鲁纳的人，现在正陷入困境。

scripts.text:

[工坊管理员]
新人？有这方面的经验吗？没关系，就算没有也能很快学会。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Now, follow after me. Grab an anchovy. Remove its head. Pull out the guts. Put it inside the container.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
现在，跟我来。拿一条鳀鱼。去掉头。掏出内脏。放进容器里。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Rookies go through these four steps, but skilled workers pick up and simultaneously remove head and guts and throw it inside the container. They are capable of one-step method.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
新人要经过这四个步骤，但熟练的工人能同时去头、掏内脏并扔进容器。他们能做到一步完成。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
The captain of Con-Chliina was especially skilled at it. Now, you guys give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
康奇利纳号的船长特别擅长这个。现在，你们试试。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What... is this.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
这...是什么。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What is this gross looking thing?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
这恶心的东西是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anchovy. You said you wanted to do something that has to do with anchovies, so I brought you here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鳀鱼。你们说想从事和鳀鱼有关的工作，所以我带你们来这里。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Anchovy is a long and thin snack That's a bit salty, Isn't it? But this thing has a head... and eyes too!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
鳀鱼是一种细长的零食，有点咸，对吧？但这东西有头...还有眼睛！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course it has eyes and head since It's a fish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它当然是鱼，所以有眼睛和头。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Anchovy is a fish?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
鳀鱼是鱼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then what did you think it was?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你们以为它是什么？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I thought it was a tasty food made from some mysterious ingredients in the store.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我以为它是商店里用某种神秘食材做成的美味食物。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys... how can you not know that an anchovy is a fish? What kind of lives did you guys live?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们...怎么不知道鳀鱼是鱼？你们以前都过的是什么日子？

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Where in the world did you find these idiots? Do you think they can handle this job?
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
你们是从哪里找来这两个笨蛋的？你们觉得他们能做这份工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I can't do this.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我做不了这个。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't think I can eat another anchovy ever again. Our eyes met just before. They're going to follow me every time I see an anchovy.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我想我再也不会吃鳀鱼了。刚才我和它四目相对。以后每次看到鳀鱼，我都会想起那双眼睛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ha... Is that so? Seems like this job is not for you either. Then Let's go find something else. Was there any other job you wanted to try?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈...是吗？看来这份工作也不适合你们。那我们去别的地方找找吧。还有没有其他想尝试的工作？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Ship. I want to be on a ^0000cdship^000000!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
船。我想上^0000cd船^000000！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. I've been living in Lasagna all this time and never been on a ship. This is a good chance to board on one.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没错。我一直住在罗札纳，却从未上过船。这是个登船的好机会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah? Then Let's go to that ^0000cdanchovy fishing boat up there^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是吗？那我们去上面那艘^0000cd鳀鱼渔船^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Didn't you say you were going to the anchovy shipping boat? Beats me what you can do there even if you go there.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
你们不是说要去鳀鱼运输船吗？就算去了，我也不知道你们能在那里做什么。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Lasagna's anchovies are special. Top quality anchovies are steamed and dried nine times, followed by removal of head and guts. This is an art work that requires delicate processes.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
罗札纳的鳀鱼很特别。顶级的鳀鱼要经过九次蒸干，然后去头去内脏。这是一门需要精细工序的艺术。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
They're perfect to be served with alcohol and make great snacks for students studying for an exam. Try one.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
它们非常适合下酒，也是备考学生的绝佳零食。尝尝看。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I've always wanted to be on a boat... hah... nostalgia...
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我一直想上船...哈哈...怀旧...

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Every time I see a boat, it reminds me of a shell. You know, the one that is empty inside and hard outside.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
每次看到船，都会让我想起贝壳。
就是那种里面是空的，外面却很硬的东西。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
What is it?
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was wondering if you need any help on the ship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在想，船上是否需要人手帮忙。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Anchovy business has definitely seen better days, but I'm always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
鳀鱼生意虽然不如从前，但我总是缺人手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then how about you give these two a try? They want to work on a ship, so even an apprenticeship would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那您不妨试试这两个人？他们想在船上工作，所以即使是当学徒也不错。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Feels like we're being sold.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
感觉我们要被卖掉了一样。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Probably just an imagination. He wouldn't sell us.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
大概只是错觉吧。他不会卖我们的。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey, you two over there. Have you ever been on a ship?
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
嘿，你们两个。以前上过船吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Nope.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没有。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Nah. My mom held my hand and came here just by riding on the tides. She was swept away and I landed here alone. Legalas found me and since then, we've been living together like a family.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
没有。我妈妈牵着我的手，只是顺着潮汐漂到了这里。她被冲走了，而我独自漂到了这里。莱加拉斯发现了我，从那以后，我们就像家人一样生活在一起。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
No need to know about your past. I just need you to do a good job on the ship. Since this is the first time on a boat for both of you, looks like there's a long bumpy road ahead.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
不需要了解你们的过去，我只需要你们在船上好好工作。既然你们俩都是第一次上船，看来前面的路会很难走啊。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
So mean. I shared my painful past and you couldn't care any less.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
好冷漠。我分享了痛苦的过去，你却毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
It's okay. I care.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没关系。我在意。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I want to share mine. Can I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我想分享我的故事。我可以告诉你吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Not really interested.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不太感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's fight!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们来打一架吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now now, calm down. How does it feel to be on a ship? It carries anchovies from the anchovy fishing boat to Lasagna, but you won't get to see them since the cargo is stored in the storage area.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了好了，冷静点。在船上感觉如何？这艘船将鳀鱼从鳀鱼渔船运送到罗札纳，但你们看不到它们，因为货物存放在仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That's not the problem I'm upset.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我生气的原因不是这个。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Why does the floor look so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
为什么地板看起来这么让人恶心？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Looks like you got a seasickness. It'll get better after a while. By then, you'll feel strange when you walk on land.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
看来你晕船了。过一会儿就会好起来的。到时候，你在陆地上走路可能会觉得有点奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Weird. The ship is firm, but why is it so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
奇怪。船很稳固，为什么我会这么恶心？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
That's because the boat moves along with the waves.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
那是因为船会随着波浪起伏。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What? Isn't the boat stuck firmly on the water?!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
什么？船不是牢牢地停在水面上吗？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
It's floating on water, not stuck on water. How can a boat move if It's stuck on water?!
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
它是浮在水面上，不是停在水面上。如果船停在水面上，它怎么动得了？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can't believe it! How can you say that such heavy boat is floating on water?!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
难以置信！你怎么能说这么重的船是浮在水面上的？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey you, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
喂，冒险者！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Take them back with you. Working on a ship doesn't require high intelligence, but these idiots probably can't even pull off a cleaning job. No, forget cleaning. I'll be lucky if they don't drive me crazy first.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
把他们带回去吧。在船上工作不需要高智商，但这几个笨蛋可能连打扫卫生都做不好。不，别说打扫卫生了。要是他们先把我逼疯，那才是我的幸运。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What do you mean you understand? You don't say such a thing like that.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你说你明白了是什么意思？你不能这么说。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This won't do. I don't think I can help you. We should go back to ^0000cdLegalas^000000 discuss the matter with him. Let's go now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样不行。我觉得我帮不了你们。我们应该回到^0000cd莱加拉斯^000000那里和他商量一下。我们现在就走吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't know what just happened, but I'm happy to go back.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我不知道刚才发生了什么，但我很高兴能回去。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yeah, Let's go back for now. This is not fun anymore.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是啊，我们先回去吧。这里一点也不好玩。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Didn't you say that you're going back to Legalas? And next time you bring some helpers, make sure they're decent.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
你不是说你要回莱加拉斯那里吗？下次你再带助手来的时候，确保他们靠谱一点。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
If you have anybody decent, bring him. I'm so short on hands that I do all of that work by myself.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
如果你有任何靠谱的人，就带他来。我人手严重不足，所有工作都只能自己干。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What is it? didn't you say that you had some business with not me, but Kalu?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
怎么了？你不是说你有事要找卡卢，而不是我吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalu! Tell Kalu that you delivered the lunchbox so we can eat!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
卡卢！告诉卡卢你已经把午餐盒送来了，这样我们就可以吃饭了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I like relaxing here as well. No craving for kalunyak either.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我也喜欢在这里放松。我也没有特别想吃卡卢尼亚克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Didn't you say you had something to say to Kalu? Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你不是说你有话要对卡卢说吗？说吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Too late. Go and report to Kalu.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
太迟了。快去告诉卡卢。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You're here already. We hate waiting, so we're thinking about just settling here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你终于来了。我们讨厌等待，所以正打算直接在这里安顿下来。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Hurry, go and deliver his lunchbox. He looks like he's about to starve to death.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
快一点，去送他的午餐盒。他看起来快要饿死了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Give that vigilante a lunchbox. I'm curious as to what's inside.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
给那个义警送个午餐盒。我很好奇里面装的是什么。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好饿。饭什么时候来？我要吃饭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Panna?

[{0}]
Panna? Here's your lunchbox...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
潘娜？这是你的午餐盒...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Where's the lunchbox? Where's mine? there's none for me! Where did you drop it? My food! My food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
午餐盒在哪里？我的呢？没有我的份！你把它掉哪里了？我的食物！我的食物！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I'll go find it right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。我现在就去找。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
He lost his mind.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
他疯了吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can understand, though. Let's go find the lunchbox.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
虽然能理解，但让我们去找午餐盒吧。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
食物！！！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What a rude, ungrateful doram.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
真是个粗鲁、不知感恩的多兰。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
How am I supposed to talk when I'm eating?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我在吃东西的时候怎么说话？

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Chomp chomp chomp.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That looks delicious...
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
看起来很好吃...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Hah, I feel much better now. I was so hungry that I was about to eat a basilisk, and you couldn't come at a better time. I almost became a doram who failed to remain as one and turn into an animal.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
哈，我现在感觉好多了。刚才饿得差点吃了基拉肯，你来得真是时候。我差点变成一个没能保持理智而变成野兽的多兰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll take the empty dishes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把空盘子收走。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
It's okay, just leave them. I'll take them with me when I go back to town later.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
没关系，就留在这里吧。我稍后回城镇时会带走的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm going.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我走了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm leaving.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我要走了。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Thanks to you, I was able to eat a hearty meal. Please tell Kalu that I'm grateful for the delicious lunch. Hopefully, today will be another safe...
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
多亏了你，我才能吃上一顿饱饭。请告诉卡卢，我很感谢这顿美味的午餐。希望今天也能平安无事...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好饿。饭什么时候来？我要吃饭。
